### 2026-07-05 summon skill page-open gate hotfix

- User symptom:
  - 三技能点击“技能”入口后，后续 `if8` / 静态格子扫描有时仍然截到属性页，导致非技能页被误判为
    `OCCUPIED`，关键 debug 图还会被后续同名文件覆盖。
- Implementation:
  - `SummonSkillService` keeps the post skill-entry wait at `1_000ms` before any 6/8-slot or static slot
    screenshot.
  - After the wait, it rechecks the existing `ZHS_shuxing` attribute anchor. If that anchor is still
    visible, it waits another `800ms` and captures/checks once more. Only when the second check still
    sees the attribute anchor is the skill tab treated as not opened and the cleanup fails closed before
    slot-count or occupied-slot scanning.
  - The initial `Alt+O` attribute-anchor lookup also gets one `800ms` retry before failing, so a single
    slow/cached screenshot does not abort the maintenance pass.
  - 三技能关键 debug 图改为唯一文件名：`summon_skill_if8_layout_roi_*`,
    `summon_skill_static_slots_raw_*`, `slot_tip_cloud_raw_*`, and yellow raw/washed tooltip files no
    longer overwrite the previous run.
  - Static slot occupancy scan no longer uses a screen-absolute ROI. It now derives a window-relative
    ROI from the current 6/8 slot centers, `52x52` boxes, and `8px` padding, then captures
    `windowBase + relativeRoi`. Slot boxes and screenshot origin now share the same coordinate system.

### 2026-07-04 CR181 本地 vision-memory NPC click 迁云收口结果

- Scope: CR181 将本地 `config/vision_memory.json` 的 NPC click learned memory 迁到外部

      `NpcClickMemoryStore`。

      污染。

      `entries.lastPredictedClick`。

      NPC click。
    - 合法 `MEMORY` click 进入 `executeNpcClickSmartQueueCandidate(...)` 共享 safety shell 和
      verifier；失败继续 poll 后续 FIFO 候选。

      `TaskCheckpoint.throwIfStopRequested(...)`，避免 HTTP interrupt 后继续 start。

### 2026-07-02 Cloud execute equivalence audit - restore non-equivalent direct hooks

- User correction: every cloud `EXECUTE` path must be behavior-equivalent to the current local path, otherwise live
  testing is meaningless. This applies to all cloud-migrated services, not only the latest NPC click failure.
- Read-only helper audit classified current services:
  - Production consumes cloud results: `TASK_CLASSIFIER`, `TRACKER_LINK_RANKER`, `TASK_POLICY`, `TASK_RECOVERY`,
    `ROUTE_MEMORY`, `ROUTE_CANDIDATE`, `IMAGE_PREPROCESS`, `MINIMAP_LOCATION`, `SUMMON_SKILL`,
    `NPC_CLICK_STRATEGY`, `DIALOG_POLICY`, `CAPABILITY_GATE`, `MAINTENANCE_THRESHOLD`, `TEAM_RETURN_POLICY`.
  - Runtime shadow/log only: `FEATURE_FLAG`, `FAILURE_CLASSIFIER`, `POLICY_VERSION`.
  - Config/service exists but production no longer consumes it after this correction: `NPC_CLICK_SMART`.
- Root issue 1 / CR165:
  - Direct `NPC_CLICK_SMART` was not equivalent to the old `clickNpcSmart(...)` pipeline. It only covered a single
    raw screenshot -> ordinary cloud click, while production still needs learned-memory, task-tooltip, yellow OCR,
    player-anchor, Ctrl menu, `Alt+C` retry, direct-combat differences, and verifier sequencing.
  - Production `NpcClickService.clickNpcSmart(...)` now uses the full old `runNpcClickPipeline(...)` again and does
    not inject/call `NpcClickSmartCloudDecisionService` or `executeNpcClickSmartCloudAction(...)`.
  - `NPC_CLICK_STRATEGY` remains the safe bridge because it only authorizes existing local strategies; it does not
    invent a new partial click path.
- Root issue 2 / CR167:
  - `DIALOG_POLICY` pre-click ran before the local option switch. A cloud miss/timeout/invalid result would block
    the old `CLICK_KEYWORD` handler, so the path was not equivalent.
  - Production `DialogService.handleDialog(...)` no longer calls `tryHandleCloudPreClickOption(...)` before the
    option switch. After-local `DIALOG_POLICY` remains for local result policy/diagnostics.
- Remaining P1 audit notes:
  - `IMAGE_PREPROCESS` is the production vision boundary and now carries most washed/metric operations. Dev sidecar
    has required-output guards, but `ROUTE_PACKED_LINE_MASK` currently maps the full washed image as one segment; if
    short route-name packed-segment behavior becomes important, it needs its own replay repair before claiming full
    equivalence.
  - `ROUTE_MEMORY` / `ROUTE_CANDIDATE` are currently safe only when they echo/authorize the local selected click or

### 2026-07-02 CR165 hotfix result - NPC_CLICK_SMART cloud-required timeout must wait/retry

- Root cause from fresh log `2026-07-02 13:37:45.250`:
  `NPC_CLICK_SMART mode=EXECUTE ... elapsedMs=328 success=false fallback=STOP reason=timeout after 300ms`。
  Because CR165 covered path is cloud-only, `NpcClickService.clickNpcSmart(...)` returned false and did not run the old
  local yellow/formula/Ctrl/`Alt+C` pipeline, so the nearby `灵兽村使者` was not clicked.
- Final rule confirmed by user:
  - `NPC_CLICK_SMART` remains the only production path for covered ordinary NPC dialog clicks.
  - No local fallback is allowed.
  - HTTP timeout / transient cloud unavailable is not a business failure. The caller must keep waiting / retrying cloud
    until cloud returns an executable/no-action response or the task is interrupted/stopped.
- Source changes:
  - `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/cloud/task/NpcClickSmartCloudDecisionService.java`
    now retries transient unavailable results (`timeout`, HTTP failure, empty response, 429/5xx) without an attempt cap,
    sleeps interruptibly for 250ms between attempts, and logs the waiting state at most every 5s.
  - `src/main/resources/application.properties` now uses `cloud.timeout-ms=60000`; `300ms` is no longer accepted as a
    cloud-required execute business boundary.
  - `src/test/java/com/bot/dhxy/cloud/task/NpcClickSmartCloudDecisionServiceTest.java`
    covers first-call `CloudDecisionClientException("timeout after 300ms")` followed by a second cloud `CLICK`, proving the
    final decision is `CLOUD_EXECUTED` and no local fallback is involved.
- Verification:
  - RED observed: `mvn -q -Dtest="NpcClickSmartCloudDecisionServiceTest#junitRunsMainSuite" test` failed with
    `status expected=CLOUD_EXECUTED actual=REQUIRED_FAILURE`.
  - GREEN: `mvn -q -Dtest="NpcClickSmartCloudDecisionServiceTest#junitRunsMainSuite" test` passed.
  - GREEN: `mvn -q -Dtest="NpcClickSmartCloudDecisionServiceTest,NpcClickSmartCloudWiringGuardTest" test` passed.

### 2026-07-02 CR163 scope correction - ImagePreprocessor still local

- 用户复核指出：CR163 不能算“洗图逻辑云端化完成”。当前实现只完成
  `imagePayloadBase64` / `payloadMimeType` / `imageSha256` 传图协议、日志脱敏、ROI/window 安全校验和
  候选坐标规范。
- 实际洗图算法仍在发布源码路径 `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/tools/ImagePreprocessor.java`：
  `washYellowText(...)`、`washGreenTextToBlackAndWhite(...)`、`washPurpleTextToBlackAndWhite(...)`、
  `washDialogOptionTemplateTextToBlackAndWhite(...)` 等方法仍会进入客户端包。
- 多个生产 caller 仍直接调用本地洗图/像素候选逻辑，包括 `DialogService`、`TaskTrackerPanelService`、
  `NpcClickService`、`SummonSkillService`、`GameTextLineOcrService`、`QuestManagerService` 和五倍 tracker
  相关路径。
- 结论：CR163 当前只能作为 image payload / cloud safety shell 基础设施。后续必须继续拆卡，把正式黄/绿/白/紫
  洗图、模板/fingerprint 前处理、候选抽取迁到真实云端；本地发布 runtime 只保留截图、ROI 裁剪、payload
  上传、坐标/置信度安全壳和输入执行。
- 用户补充并确认两个后续 contract 模式：
  - `RETURN_WASHED_IMAGE`：本地传 raw image/ROI，云端返回洗好的图 payload；本地只用洗后图做非常薄的纯匹配，
    不保留颜色阈值、洗图、二值化、fingerprint 前处理算法。
  - `CLOUD_INTERNAL_PREPROCESS`：像 NPC click / Navigation / 三技能 / Dialog 这类嵌套服务，云端内部完成洗图、
    候选抽取、匹配、排序、fallback/retry 策略，直接返回业务结果或窗口相对点击点；本地不拿中间洗图，也不能
    在云失败后回退到旧本地洗图逻辑。
  - 两种模式共同红线：洗图算法不能留在发布 runtime。本地只保留截图、ROI 裁剪、payload 上传、返回 schema
    校验、窗口/ROI/置信度安全壳和极薄执行层。
- 已更新 `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md` CR163 row/card，并需要同步 dashboard。

### 2026-07-02 cloud vision / washing boundary decision

- 用户明确：`ImagePreprocessor` 级别的洗字/图像预处理是核心资产，发布 runtime 不能留在本地。
  黄字、绿字、白字、紫字等 washed image 处理，以及依赖 washed image 的模板匹配/指纹/候选抽取，
  都应迁到云端。本地只负责截图、裁剪、上传 raw image/ROI、窗口相对坐标安全校验和真实输入。
- 三技能后续 CR 边界：本地打开面板、hover、截图；云端洗 tooltip、识别槽位状态、决定删除/保留/重试、
  返回动作和窗口相对坐标。生产路径不能继续调用本地 `washYellowText` 或本地三技能状态模板匹配作为 fallback。
- Navigation 后续 CR 边界：本地可以打开地图、输入、滚动、执行点击和等待 pathing；云端必须决定世界地图黄色
  候选点击、小地图点击点、route candidate/memory/地图转换策略。生产路径不能保留可用的黄字洗图、
  候选排序或地图转换资产 fallback。
- NPC click smart 后续 CR 边界：本地只传当前窗口 raw image/ROI、target facts 和上一次尝试结果；
  云端负责 ROI 裁剪、洗图、黄字/紫字/菜单识别、目标候选、首点公式、Ctrl 菜单 fallback、retry 状态机，
  并返回普通点击/`Ctrl`+点击/快捷键+点击/重新截图/终止等受限动作。本地只执行动作、验证结果并把失败反馈给云端，
  不保留旧 smart-click 识别和 fallback 状态机作为生产 fallback。
- 已补流程纠偏：后续任何云端化 CR 立项前，谢帅/main agent 必须先主动做核心资产盘点，把涉及的
  视觉识别、洗字、模板/指纹、候选排序、坐标转换、fallback 状态机、学习记忆、失败归因分成
  `cloud-required / local-safety-only / transitional-local`，不再等用户逐项指出。
- 详细记录已写入 `docs/HYBRID_CLOUD_WORKFLOW.md` section `26. Cloud Asset / Vision Boundary Decisions`。

Review repair (2026-07-01):

  re-apply cloud policy after `taskTransactionRunner.run(...)` returns.

  cloud replacement, and cloud `result=STOPPED` still rejects.

  `TASK_POLICY` execute. A sidecar echo of local `phase=...;result=...;yield=...;next=...` without
  `reason` is rejected and keeps local.

  `result/yield/next` into
  `result=...;yield=...;next=...;reason=dev-local-task-policy`, so local dev execute samples remain
  strict and meaningful. Tracker-link and route behavior were not changed.

    return instead of before `phaseOutcome.set(outcome)` / `return outcome.transactionResult()`.

    `cloud.services.route-memory.execute-percent=0`; CR-HC-013 must flip only these two route
    services to execute-enabled/100 while leaving NPC/dialog/battle/return/team/input settings

  `RouteCloudDecisionServiceTest` for valid cloud execute, invalid schema/coordinate rejection,
  execute-disabled local behavior, and retained local shadow/oracle result; plus an updated
  navigation/config source guard replacing the old shadow-only route assertions.

Implementation:

- Added route-specific execute envelope/service:
  `RouteCloudDecision` and `RouteCloudDecisionService`.
- `RouteCloudDecisionService` calls the existing `CloudDecisionCoordinator` with a route-specific
  execute gate for only `ROUTE_MEMORY` and `ROUTE_CANDIDATE`.
- Accepted cloud clicks require `diagnostics.coordinateSpace=WINDOW_RELATIVE`, parseable
  `click=<windowX>,<windowY>`, and a point inside the 1024x768 window. Invalid schema/coordinate is
  returned as explicit no-click/rejection with `executed=false`; it is not reported as cloud success.
- `NavigationService` keeps old route calculations as local shadow/oracle text and now asks the
  route service before the real route-result click is submitted:
  - legacy route-result memory hit;
  - legacy route-result memory local miss with cloud `lookup=HIT`;
  - yellow route-result memory hit;
  - yellow route-result memory local miss with cloud `lookup=HIT`;
  - yellow destination OCR route candidate;
  - legacy coordinate OCR route candidate.
- Successful cloud execute replaces the old local window-relative row/link click. Local mini-map
  final-coordinate handling and pathing confirmation stay in local code.
- Route candidate success no longer sends a second post-click cloud sample; failure/no-click
  statuses still report after the local scan result is known.
- `application.properties` now enables only:
  `cloud.services.route-memory.execute-enabled=true`,
  `cloud.services.route-memory.execute-percent=100`,
  `cloud.services.route-candidate.execute-enabled=true`, and
  `cloud.services.route-candidate.execute-percent=100`.
- Local dev sidecar now adds `diagnostics.coordinateSpace=WINDOW_RELATIVE` for route responses that
  contain `click=`.

  `before-focus`, `before-transaction-focus`, `before-actions`, each action boundary, and
  `before-exclusive-callback`.

  focus manually inside the input transaction only after a fresh pause checkpoint, so a pause between
  the initial checkpoint and real focus cannot focus the game window during pause.
- Review repair: `InputActionScope.isCancelled()` is now a generic exclusive-callback pause
  checkpoint. It waits on pause and continues after resume; stop while paused still cancels/throws.
- Focused guard updated in `InputActionPauseCancellationGuardTest`: pause before focus, pause between
  actions, stop while paused, identity drift while paused, exclusive callback pause-before-entry,
  pause just before transaction focus, pause inside exclusive callback before the next direct step,

## 2026-07-01 / CR148 local-team session 完成后解绑

Status: Source implemented / independent review passed / local verification passed / fresh runtime pending.

Owner:

- Worker: 纸质人体。
- Reviewer: 唐德/谢帅第三视角复审。

User decision:

- 采用“队长完成后旧 `localTeamSessionKey` 失效，队员退回无绑定维护语义”。
- 不采用“队长重启复用上一次 ID”。

Problem evidence / observed symptom:

- 五个号同批做五倍，队长完成设置轮数后停止，队员仍在自动战斗。
- 用户随后单独重启队长，观察到队员不再按预期补血/补蓝/三技能维护。
- 当前判断：这不是 task-turn 公平性问题，而是旧 local-team session/capability gate 仍影响队员。

Implementation boundary:

- 不要硬改 `TaskExecutionContext.localTeamSessionKey`；该字段是 final。
- 优先在 `TaskMaintenanceService` 侧维护 session lifecycle：leader/queue 完成后把旧 session 标记
  invalid/completed，让旧 context 的 `isLocalSupportMemberSession(...)` 返回 false。

## 2026-06-30 / CR136 修罗 same-millisecond combat-exit signal race

Status: source fixed / focused guard and compile passed / fresh runtime pending.

Evidence:

- Runtime `2026-06-30 18:26:58.751 -> 18:57:02.129` showed 修罗 round 22 false fast-exit entered
  `RETURN_HOME`, used the cached return item once, then watcher correctly forced `IN_COMBAT`.
- `18:27:09.091` trusted `IN_COMBAT` refreshed the fast-exit avatar baseline and resumed
  `WAIT_COMBAT`.
- `18:27:09.562` real combat exit was emitted as `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED sequence=469`, but the next
  wait arm logged `discard stale combat-exit signal ... pendingAtMs=1782858429562
  armedAtMs=1782858429562`.
- After that, round 22 stayed in `WAIT_COMBAT` through the latest visible `18:57:02.129` log and did
  not enter `RETURN_HOME` again.

Repair:

- `BattleRadarService.armExpectedCombatExitWait(...)` now preserves same-millisecond current-cycle
  pending exit signals. The stale arm-stage boundary changed from `combatExitPendingAtMs <= now` to
  strict `combatExitPendingAtMs < now`, matching the consume-side rule that only strictly older
  signals are stale.
- The method comment now documents why same-millisecond exit/arm timestamps must be kept:
  `System.currentTimeMillis()` cannot reliably order events inside the same millisecond.
- `WubeiCR136FastExitLifecycleWiringTest` now guards this race by requiring
  `state.combatExitPendingAtMs < now` in the arm method and forbidding
  `state.combatExitPendingAtMs <= now`.
- The guard was run red before the source fix:
  `Arming an expected wait must keep same-millisecond exit signals; only strictly older signals are stale`.
- After the fix, focused verification passed:
  - `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile`
  - `mvn -q -DskipTests "-Dexec.classpathScope=test" "-Dexec.mainClass=com.bot.dhxy.task.wubei.WubeiCR136FastExitLifecycleWiringTest" org.codehaus.mojo:exec-maven-plugin:3.1.0:java`
  - `mvn -q -DskipTests "-Dexec.classpathScope=test" "-Dexec.mainClass=com.bot.dhxy.window.execution.WindowTaskRunnerPausedLeaderReadOnlyObserverWiringTest" org.codehaus.mojo:exec-maven-plugin:3.1.0:java`
  - `mvn -q -DskipTests "-Dexec.classpathScope=test" "-Dexec.mainClass=com.bot.dhxy.window.execution.WindowTaskRunnerCombatStartupDeferWiringTest" org.codehaus.mojo:exec-maven-plugin:3.1.0:java`

## 2026-06-30 / CR145 三技能维护队列与延后一轮消费

Status: implementation and independent review PASS / fresh runtime pending.

Owner:

- Coordinator: 唐德.
- Implementation: subagent worker.
- Review: subagent reviewer + 唐德 final local review.

Scope:

- Change summon-skill maintenance scheduling from "due -> execute immediately" to "due -> enqueue;
  consume old queue snapshot in the next safe maintenance window".
- Wubei consumes at most 1 summon-skill queue item per window; Xiuluo consumes at most 2.
- Queue item uniqueness is per window/account/type; duplicate due checks do not refresh `enqueuedAt`
  or add another item.
- Success dequeues and refreshes summon-skill cooldown; retryable failure moves the item to queue tail
  without refreshing cooldown.
- Maintenance window close behavior must not keep a summon-skill window open waiting for items that
  become due after the current window opened.

Approved design:

- Add a maintenance queue for `SUMMON_SKILL`; due detection enqueues and returns a deferred/queued
  status instead of cleaning in the same turn.
- Opened maintenance windows consume only queue items whose `enqueuedAt` is earlier than the
  window-open snapshot time.
- Items added while the window is already open wait until the next window, even if budget remains.
- Wubei budget: 1; Xiuluo budget: 2.
- Success removes the item and updates the cooldown timestamp; failure moves the item to the queue
  tail and keeps cooldown unchanged.
- No visual matching, click coordinate, navigation, expected-combat, return-home, bag, green-link,
  prepared-action, or SummonSkillService slot algorithm changes.

Verification required:

- Focused source/unit guard for queue dedupe, snapshot eligibility, task budgets, success cooldown,
  failure tail move, and no same-window immediate execution.
- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile`
- `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile`
- Fresh runtime: 五倍 due logs enqueue in current round, next maintenance window handles only one
  old item; 修罗 handles at most two old items; no 三技能 window appears right before prepared
  enter-battle because of same-round due.

Implementation 2026-06-30:

- `TaskMaintenanceService` now owns a private `SUMMON_SKILL` maintenance queue:
  - due checks enqueue `windowKey + playerIdentityEpoch + SUMMON_SKILL` if absent and return
    `SUMMON_SKILL_DEFERRED`;
  - duplicate due checks do not append another item and do not refresh `enqueuedAt`;
  - `openTeamPathingMaintenanceWindow(...)` records `windowOpenedAt`, and consumption only selects
    current-window items with `enqueuedAt < windowOpenedAt`;
  - success removes the item and refreshes cooldown through the existing success path;
  - retryable failure moves the same item to the queue tail, records attempt/failure reason, and
    does not refresh `lastSummonSkillCleanAtByWindow`;
  - player identity drift clears old queued items for that window along with the old cooldown/cache.
- `XiuluoTaskV2.runLeaderPathingSummonSkillMaintenance(...)` now passes
  `.maxSummonSkillCleanersPerTeamRound(2)`. `WubeiTask` already passes `1`.
- `SummonSkillService`, OCR/template/click/slot logic, navigation, green-link, prepared
  enter-battle, expected-combat, return-home, bag, incense, NPC click, and visual matching paths were
  not changed.

    already contained unrelated CR141 paused-observer and CR142 coordinate-arrival changes. CR144
    implementation must build on those changes without reverting them.

Problem evidence:

- `2026-06-30 14:33` 五倍普通/黄袍 enter-battle path:
  - Runner published `PREPARED_ACTION_READY sequence=63` for `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` while the leader
    was busy in opportunistic 三技能 maintenance.
  - After maintenance released the turn, the prepared action was older than
    `WUBEI_PREPARED_DIALOG_MAX_AGE_MS=3000ms`.
  - Runner kept seeing visible `OPTION`, but `refreshTaskDialogInterestPreparationSignal(...)`
    returned existing prepared action from the `already current` branch and did not republish.
  - Task side did not progress; window stood still with `existingPreparedAgeMs` increasing.

Approved design:

- Runner owns this recovery, not 五倍 task business phase code.
- Reprepare only when the window is stationary. Moving windows must not republish stale prepared
  actions merely because age exceeded the freshness window.
- Required gate: current task dialog interest + matching visible dialog + existing prepared supports
  current interest + stale verified age + stationary pathing/runtime evidence + per-window/operation
  cooldown.
- Add structured logs and focused guards; then run compile/test-compile and local review.

Implementation:

- Published CR144 in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md` and regenerated the CR dashboard snapshot.
- Implementation was delegated to subagent worker, then locally revised after review.
- `WindowTaskRunner.refreshTaskDialogInterestPreparationSignal(...)` now handles the stale
  existing-current path by clearing and re-preparing only when all gates hold:
  - existing prepared action is stale for the current task interest;
  - visible dialog has the same explicit non-`NONE` `DialogType`;
  - pathing snapshot is terminal stationary (`ARRIVED` / `STOPPED_AWAY`) and not probing;
  - same-window cooldown is open.
- Moving/unknown states and coordinate-still guesses are deliberately not treated as stationary.
- Stale retained logs that do not trigger reprepare were lowered to debug to avoid watcher tick
  noise.
- Added `src/test/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/execution/WindowTaskRunnerStalePreparedRepublishWiringTest.java`
  source guard.

Review:

- Independent reviewer found P1/P2/P3 issues in the first worker patch:
  - stationary gate accepted moving/unknown evidence too broadly;
  - moving-negative was not guarded;
  - retained stale log could spam at watcher frequency;
  - null / `NONE` dialog type behaved like wildcard.
- 唐德 repaired all four points. Second independent review reported PASS with no P1/P2/P3
  blocker.

  input/dialog prepare/maintenance remain paused; member pause remains quiet.

  source of truth.

Implementation:

- `WindowTaskRunner.runCombatWatcherLoop(...)` now checks
  `executionContext.isPauseRequested() && windowContext.isLeader()` before the normal pause
  checkpoint.
- Paused leader windows enter `paused-leader-readonly-observer`; the branch runs a stop-only
  `TaskCheckpoint` check, calls `AutoCombatService.probePausedWindowCombatStateReadOnly(...)`, logs
  `inputAllowed=false` and `preparedActionAllowed=false`, then sleeps on the normal observer wake
  cadence.
- The paused leader branch does not call `publishCombatStateChanged(...)`, because that existing
  publisher has 五倍/修罗 pathing cleanup side effects. Battle enter/exit evidence is instead left
  in `BattleRadarService` pending signals for task phases to consume after resume.
- `AutoCombatService.probePausedWindowCombatStateReadOnly(...)` only calls
  `battleRadarService.checkAndSyncCombatState()` and logs diagnostics. It does not call
  `maybeHandleCombatEnter(...)`, consume exit signals, touch `AutoCombatPanelService`, input queue,
  maintenance, dialog prepare, task tracker prepare, NPC, bag, or navigation code.
- `TaskCheckpoint.throwIfStopRequested(TaskStopToken, String)` is the new stop-only checkpoint for
  read-only observers that must not block on a pause token.
- Second-review P1-1 repair:
  - `BattleRadarService` now records `combatExitAfterUnconsumedEnterPending` when exit occurs while
    the combat-enter signal is still unconsumed.
  - That current-cycle marker lets `armExpectedCombatExitWait(...)` keep the paused full combat-cycle
    exit instead of discarding it as stale, and lets `consumeCombatExitSignalForExpectedWait(...)`
    consume it after resume.
  - The same exit clears the stale enter signal, and `AutoCombatService.maybeHandleCombatEnter(...)`
    refuses to consume/open enter maintenance unless `GameContext.ActionState` is still `IN_COMBAT`.
- Second-review P1-2 repair:
  - `WindowRuntimeContext.wakeObserver(...)` increments `observerWakeSeq` without publishing any
    business ready event.
  - `WindowTaskRunner.pauseCurrentTask()` calls it only for leader windows, so members remain quiet.
  - Paused leader readonly observation uses fixed `WINDOW_PAUSED_LEADER_READONLY_INTERVAL_MS=500ms`
    instead of `getDynamicPollingIntervalMs()`; `FREE` state can no longer stretch the pause observer
    to 10s.
- Third-review P1 repair:
  - `AutoCombatService.probePausedWindowCombatStateReadOnly(...)` now records action state before and
    after `battleRadarService.checkAndSyncCombatState()`.
  - When paused readonly observation sees `IN_COMBAT -> FREE`, it calls
    `battleRadarService.markCombatExitObservedDuringPause(source)`.
  - `BattleRadarService` now records `combatExitObservedDuringPausePending` with the pending battle
    count. This covers the case where the normal watcher already consumed enter before the task armed
    `FAST_EXPECTED_EXIT`.
  - `armExpectedCombatExitWait(...)` and `consumeCombatExitSignalForExpectedWait(...)` use
    `isCurrentExpectedWaitAllowedExit(...)`, which allows either unconsumed-enter exits or
    paused-observed exits for the current battle cycle.
  - `clearCombatExitPending(...)` clears both current-cycle markers.

## 2026-06-30 / CR141 通用队长暂停只读观察语义建卡

Status: card created / no source change.

Scope:

- Record the pause/resume bug reproduced around `2026-06-30 10:35-10:37`.
- Create sprint board row and detailed card for a generic leader paused read-only observer.
- This is not a 五倍-specific card; 五倍 is only the observed sample.

Summary:

- Root cause: pausing freezes both task phase execution and the runner/combat watcher. If the leader
  pauses immediately after clicking an enter-battle dialog and the real combat finishes during the
  pause, no component records the intermediate `IN_COMBAT -> FREE` transition. On resume, the task
  can still believe it is waiting for enter-battle evidence and get stuck.
- Required direction recorded in CR141: while paused, leader windows may keep a pure read-only
  combat-state observer; all input, dialog prepare/click, maintenance, navigation, and task phase
  progress remain paused. Member windows keep the existing quiet pause behavior.

Files updated:

- `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `docs/ACTIVE_WORK.md`

Validation:

- Documentation-only card creation. No Java source changed and no testcase replay required.
- `node scripts/generate-cr-dashboard-data.js` should be run after this entry so
  `docs/cr-dashboard-data.js` includes CR141.

## 2026-06-29 / CR136 修罗 ReturnItemUseResult nested Status NoClassDef follow-up

Status: repaired / focused guard, compile, and test-compile passed / fresh runtime pending.

Context:

- User correctly called out that the `2026-06-29 18:17:25` stop was not a user restart issue. It was
  a CR136 delivery/runtime safety issue.
- The fresh restarted app at `18:14:28` ran from `D:\mavenProject\DHXY\target\classes`, started
  修罗 at `18:14:41`, then failed in first-round `RETURN_HOME` after cached return verification.
- Failure evidence:
  - `18:17:25.871` `[xiuluo-v2] cached return item verified ... 灵兽村`.
  - `18:17:25.872` `task transaction fatal error: name=xiuluo-v2:RETURN_HOME`.
  - `NoClassDefFoundError: com/bot/dhxy/task/xiuluo/XiuluoTaskV2$ReturnItemUseResult$Status`.

Root cause:

- CR136 修罗 parity introduced `ReturnItemUseResult.Status` as a private enum nested inside the
  private record `ReturnItemUseResult`.
- That generates a separate lazy-loaded runtime class:
  `XiuluoTaskV2$ReturnItemUseResult$Status.class`.
- The app can start without this class because the branch is loaded only when `ReturnItemUseResult`
  creates a verified/unverified result. When the first cached return verification succeeded, the JVM
  tried to load the nested enum and failed.
- This is still a code-delivery defect under CR136: the CR must not leave the live return-home path
  dependent on an extra nested enum class that can fail only at first runtime branch execution.

Repair:

- `XiuluoTaskV2.ReturnItemUseResult` no longer has a nested `Status` enum.
- The result now stores the same three states with simple record booleans:
  `verifiedStartMap`, `usedStartMapUnverified`, and `location`.
- `useReturnItemAndVerifyStartMap(...)` now checks `result.verifiedStartMap()` and
  `result.usedStartMapUnverified()`; CR136 business behavior is unchanged.
- Added a CR136 source guard to `XiuluoCR136FastExitLifecycleWiringTest` requiring no
  `ReturnItemUseResult.Status` / `private enum Status` dependency in this return-item result path.

Verification:

- RED:
  `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile; java -cp "target/test-classes;target/classes" com.bot.dhxy.task.xiuluo.XiuluoCR136FastExitLifecycleWiringTest`
  failed with `CR136 return-item result must not depend on an extra nested Status enum class`.
- GREEN:
  same command passed after the production change.
- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed.
- `target/classes/com/bot/dhxy/task/xiuluo` now contains `XiuluoTaskV2$ReturnItemUseResult.class`
  and no `XiuluoTaskV2$ReturnItemUseResult$Status.class`.

Fresh runtime still needed:

- Restart from the newly compiled `target/classes` and rerun 修罗. The first cached/normal return-home
  verification path must not throw `NoClassDefFoundError`, and CR136 false-fast-exit validation still
  needs live evidence.

  `RETURN_HOME`.

  trusted read-only combat probe and does not continue to full scan / second attempt in the same
  correction episode.

  `WAIT_COMBAT`. This does not disable/degrade/invalidate future avatar fast-exit; a later trigger is
  a new correction episode with a fresh one-use budget.

  phase retry path and falls back to normal start-map navigation instead of consuming more items.

  `maintenance team pathing window opened`.

  - `assignmentRole`: effective role used only for task reassignment, where the old cached `windowContext.role`
    fallback may still preserve assignment behavior.

  `liveRole=UNKNOWN + cached WindowRole.LEADER` no longer becomes live leader evidence.
- `AutoBattleTask.maybeRunIdleMaintenance(...)` now has two summon-skill gate modes:
  - local support session: use local `TeamSupportCapability.SUMMON_SKILL`;
  - non-local follower support for team tasks (`xiuluo_v2` / `wubei` / `wuhuan_v2`): use the legacy
    `teamMaintenanceKey=requestedTaskCode` plus `requireOpenTeamMaintenanceWindow=true`.
- This keeps `17:55`-style队员三技能 blocked until the leader actually opens the pathing maintenance window.

## 2026-06-29 / CR138 heartbeat review 21:16 stale-role fallback P1

Status: review / new P1 source blocker recorded / no Java behavior changes.

Scope:

- Re-read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/DHXY_CONTEXT.md`, current CR138 card, and latest `ACTIVE_WORK`.
- Reviewed current CR138 source paths for implementation growth and behavior blockers:
  - `WindowTaskControlService.startSameQueue(...)`
  - `MultiWindowTaskManager.submitQueueWithResult(...)`
  - `WindowTaskRunner.submit(...)`, `resolveTaskTypeBeforeStart(...)`, and context building
  - `TaskMaintenanceService` local-team session/capability state
  - `AutoBattleTask`, `AutoCombatService`, `TeamReturnService`
- No Java/OCR/template/click/navigation behavior changed in this pass.

Finding:

- New P1: CR138 still has a stale-role fallback path before local-session leader evidence.
- `WindowTaskRunner.resolveTaskTypeBeforeStart(...)` calls
  `teamRoleDetectionService.detectCurrentRole(...)`, but when that live probe returns `UNKNOWN`, it
  falls back to `windowContext.getRole()`.
- The CR138 repair then calls
  `taskMaintenanceService.markLocalTeamWindowRoleDetected(..., role.name(), "runner-role-preflight")`
  after that fallback. This means a registration/UI snapshot role can still be recorded as the
  local-team session's live role evidence.
- Evidence that `windowContext.role` is not live-only:
  - `WindowRuntimeContext.applyRegistration(...)` writes `request.getRole()` into the runtime role.
  - `NativeWindowRegistrationMapper.toRegistrationRequests(...)` can assign the first discovered
    window `WindowRole.LEADER` and the rest `MEMBER`.
  - `WindowRegistrationBatchBuilder.buildTeam(...)` also creates legacy team registrations with
    positional `LEADER/MEMBER` roles.
- Existing guards cover `TaskMaintenanceService.hasDetectedLocalLeader(...)`, but they do not cover
  this upstream contamination where the runner passes a fallback role as if it were live evidence.

Impact:

- A selected window whose live role probe is `UNKNOWN` can still be treated as the CR138 local
  leader because its cached/registration role says `LEADER`.
- Members may then enter local support capability gates even though no selected local leader was
  live-detected. This reopens the stale snapshot class of bug from a different entry point.

Required repair direction:

- Split `resolveTaskTypeBeforeStart(...)` into raw live role evidence and effective assignment role.
- It is acceptable to keep the old `windowContext.role` fallback for task assignment only if the
  business still wants that behavior, but CR138 session evidence must use the raw live role:
  - only raw `LEADER` may call/produce local leader evidence;
  - raw `MEMBER`/`SOLO` may count as non-leader evidence;
  - raw `UNKNOWN` must not be promoted to leader via `windowContext.role` unless that cached role has
    explicit fresh-live provenance.
- Add a focused guard for `liveRole=UNKNOWN` + cached `WindowRole.LEADER`: the session must not
  become `isLocalSupportMemberSession(...)` from that cached role alone.

Verification this pass:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile`
- `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile`

Current conclusion:

- CR138 is not Done.
- The previous partial-submit P1 is fixed, but this stale-role fallback is now an active P1 blocker
  before fresh runtime acceptance.

## 2026-06-29 / CR138 partial-submit unknown-leader P1 repair

Status: review / P1 source blocker fixed / focused guards pass / fresh runtime pending. Owner: 唐德.

Scope:

- Continued CR138 review after the reported complexity cleanup.
- Touched only CR138 local-team session resolution and focused guards:
  - `TaskMaintenanceService`
  - `TaskMaintenanceCR138LocalSupportCapabilityTest`
  - `CR138ReviewCaveatWiringTest`
- No OCR/template/click/movement/navigation behavior changed.

Finding:

- Unknown-leader partial-submit could leave members pending forever:
  - `WindowTaskControlService.startSameQueue(...)` calls `completeLocalTeamSessionWindow(...)` for a
    submit-failed candidate.
  - The failed candidate never reaches runner live-role preflight, so it never enters
    `roleDetectedWindows`.
  - Before this repair, `TaskMaintenanceService.markLocalTeamWindowRoleDetected(...)` confirmed
    leader-absent only when `roleDetectedWindows.containsAll(candidateWindows)`.
  - If every started candidate live-detected as non-leader, `leaderAbsent` still stayed false because
    the submit-failed candidate was missing from `roleDetectedWindows`.

Repair:

- `TaskMaintenanceService.markLocalTeamWindowRoleDetected(...)` now computes resolved candidates from
  `roleDetectedWindows union completedWindows` before confirming leader-absent.
- This keeps the existing cleanup semantics while also treating submit-failed/completed-without-role
  candidates as resolved for the no-local-leader fallback decision.
- Added a focused behavior guard:
  unknown-leader candidates `[partial-submit-member, partial-submit-failed]`, failed candidate marked
  complete, remaining candidate live-detects `MEMBER`; pending leader detection must end and local
  support must remain off.
- Added a source guard requiring the leader-absent path to include `completedWindows`.

Verification:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile`

## 2026-06-29 / CR138 stale snapshot leader 复审

Status: review / P1 source blocker found / no Java behavior changes in this pass. Owner: 唐德.

Accepted:

  UI snapshot before live role preflight.

  `TaskExecutionContext.localLeaderWindowId` as a detected leader.

  members can still become `isLocalSupportMemberSession(...)` because the expected leader id is
  nonblank. They then wait for local capabilities that no leader task will open, instead of falling
  back through leader-absent ordinary auto-battle behavior.

  have reported; if none is leader, mark leader-absent and let members behave as standalone/non-local
  auto-battle.
- Add a focused guard for stale leader snapshot:
  - member context has `localLeaderWindowId=stale-leader`;
  - no `markLocalTeamLeaderDetected(...)` has run;
  - `isLocalSupportMemberSession(...)` must be false;
  - after all candidates are marked non-leader, local support gates remain off and fallback is allowed.

## 2026-06-29 / CR138 candidate-session pre-leader gap 复审

Status: review / source blocker found / docs-dashboard update. No Java, OCR/template, click,
navigation, task flow, or runtime logic changed in this pass.

Scope:

- Reviewed the latest CR138 implementation after 1384R reported P1/P2 fixed.
- Focused on the previous blocker areas:
  - `WindowTaskRunner.submit(...)` queue collapse before live role preflight;
  - `TeamReturnService` no-match diagnostics;
  - unknown-role local-team session candidate behavior before a live leader is detected.

Accepted from this review:

- The old submit-time queue collapse blocker is fixed:
  - `WindowTaskRunner.submit(...)` no longer calls `collapseLocalSupportQueue(...)`.
  - Live role preflight still owns member -> `AUTO_BATTLE` reassignment through
    `TaskTeamAssignmentPolicy.resolveTaskForRole(...)`.
- The old `leaderSignalPresent` diagnostic caveat is fixed:
  - `TeamReturnService.logReturnButtonNoMatch(...)` now logs `currentWindowReturnMarkerPresent`.

New P1 blocker:

- `WindowTaskControlService.startSameQueue(...)` creates an unknown-leader local-team candidate and
  submits all selected windows with `localLeaderPresent=true`.
- Before any runner live-detects `LEADER`, `TaskMaintenanceService.isLocalSupportMemberSession(...)`
  returns false because `hasDetectedLocalLeader(...)` is not yet satisfied.
- In that pre-leader-detection gap:
  - `AutoBattleTask.maybeRunIdleMaintenance(...)` may still run the legacy ungated
    `teamReturnService.clickReturnTeamIfPresent(context, "auto-battle")` path;
  - `AutoCombatService.runPendingFollowerFirstAidIfAllowed(...)` may fall back to the old
    `requestedTaskCode` first-aid gate when `requested=wubei/xiuluo_v2`.
- Risk:
  - Candidate members can still click return-team before the local leader release.
  - If no local leader is eventually detected, or if leader detection lags, members can again wait on
    stale requested-task gates instead of behaving as standalone/non-local auto-battle.

Required repair:

- Separate candidate/pending-leader state from active local-support state and standalone/non-local
  auto-battle.
- Candidate members must suppress legacy return-team click and old requested-task first-aid gates
  until leader detection resolves the session.
- After live leader detection, members should use capability gates only.
- If the selected batch is proven to have no local leader, clear/disable the candidate session and
  let those windows behave as ordinary standalone/non-local auto-battle.
- Add a focused guard for this exact pre-leader gap.

## 2026-06-29 / CR138 unknown-role same-queue local session 修复

Status: review / source blocker fixed / fresh runtime pending. Owner: 唐德.

Scope:

- Rechecked latest CR138 feedback. The correction is valid: the 14:04 run did click return-team, but
  those member paths still logged `requested=wubei localSession=null localSupportMember=false`.
- This pass intentionally does not change 摄妖香 / 摄药箱 / sheyaoxiang ordering or speed. User
  explicitly scoped this round to the other CR138 issue.
- Touched only CR138 local-session creation and live leader detection wiring:
  - `WindowTaskControlService`
  - `MultiWindowTaskManager`
  - `WindowTaskRunner`
  - `TaskMaintenanceService`
  - `CR138ReviewCaveatWiringTest`
- No OCR/template/click/movement/navigation logic changed.

Root cause:

- UI same-queue submit created the CR138 local-team session only when the current UI snapshot already
  knew a selected window was `LEADER`.
- In the fresh run, role detection happened later inside `WindowTaskRunner.resolveTaskTypeBeforeStart(...)`.
  At submit time the selected windows could still be `UNKNOWN` / stale, so no local session was
  attached to the batch.
- Members therefore fell back to old generic `auto_battle requested=wubei` behavior; return-team could
  still happen through the legacy path, but first-aid / local support capability logs could not prove
  CR138's session gate was active.

Change:

- `WindowTaskControlService.startSameQueue(...)` now creates a local-team session candidate for
  multi-window queues that contain team-role main tasks, even when the UI snapshot has no known leader
  yet. Known-leader submit still uses the safer leader-first path.
- `WindowTaskRunner.submit(...)` now preserves the local-team session candidate without requiring
  `localLeaderWindowId != null`; it also resolves the leader window id after live role sync when the
  runner detects itself as leader.
- `WindowTaskRunner.resolveTaskTypeBeforeStart(...)` calls
  `TaskMaintenanceService.markLocalTeamLeaderDetected(...)` after a runner live-detects `LEADER`.
- `TaskMaintenanceService.isLocalSupportMemberSession(...)` now requires a detected local leader
  before treating a member as local support. This prevents external-leader / pure挂机 batches from
  accidentally using a candidate session before a selected local leader is proven.
- `CR138ReviewCaveatWiringTest` now guards the candidate-session path, the no-`leaderWindowId`
  submission rule, live leader detection registration, and the detected-leader requirement.

Verification:

- Green: `java -cp "target\\test-classes;target\\classes" com.bot.dhxy.service.CR138ReviewCaveatWiringTest`
- Green with Maven dependency classpath:
  - `TaskMaintenanceCR138LocalSupportCapabilityTest`
  - `AutoBattleCR138TeamReturnReleaseWiringTest`
  - `AutoCombatCR138FirstAidGateWiringTest`
  - `AutoCombatCR138FirstAidOnlyCommonBoxGuardTest`
  - `LeaderTeamReturnCR138ReleaseWiringTest`
  - `TeamReturnCR138NoMatchDiagnosticsWiringTest`
- Green: `mvn -q -DskipTests compile`

Fresh runtime to verify:

- Starting continuous `[五倍, 修罗]` with UI roles initially unknown should log
  `local-team session candidate without known leader`, then a later
  `maintenance local-team leader detected`.
- After leader detection, member support logs should show `localSession=... localSupportMember=true`
  instead of staying on `localSession=null localSupportMember=false`.
- The previous stale `requested=wubei` label may still appear as an audit/request label in some
  support paths, but first-aid / left-top / summon-skill / common-box / team-return decisions should

## 2026-06-28 / 五倍接任务后后台 tracker 读图与暗雷快重抽

Status: implemented and locally verified. User requested the normal accept path and priority
prepared-accept path to share one behavior: after accepting a 五倍 task, do not wait before
prepath; start the 宝象国 in-map prepath immediately while a bound-window background tracker read
captures/matches the left tracker after 1 second.

- Implementation:
  - `TaskTrackerPanelService.WUBEI_TRACKER_TITLE_TEMPLATES` now tries `殿前献艺` first so
    暗雷怪 is recognized before ordinary/probe/chained task titles.
  - `WubeiTask` normal accept success and priority prepared-accept success both delegate to
    `afterAcceptTaskSucceeded(...)`.
  - `afterAcceptTaskSucceeded(...)` confirms the NPC click, schedules `schedulePostAcceptTrackerPanelRead(...)`,
    then immediately runs `startPostAcceptPrepath(...)`; the 1-second tracker delay happens in
    the background future, not after the mini-map prepath returns.
  - The background read uses `windowTaskContextHolder.callWith(runtime, ...)` so screenshots stay
    bound to the same window while the foreground thread is doing `Alt+C` / current-map click.
  - `READ_TRACKER` consumes the background result when available; if the background read misses,
    it falls back to the existing direct tracker read/recovery path.
  - When `READ_TRACKER` identifies `殿前献艺`/暗雷怪, it clears `currentTrackerPanel`,
    clears only `wubei:post-accept-prepath:*` pathing signals, removes the old fixed `4s` sleep,
    and returns directly to `ROUTE_TO_MAIN_TASK` for reroll.
- Verification:
  - `WubeiPostAcceptDarkThunderRerollWiringTest` -> passed.
  - `WubeiCR134PostAcceptPrepathTargetWiringTest` -> passed.
  - `WubeiTrackerTaskKindTemplateWiringTest` -> passed.
  - `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` -> passed.

## 2026-06-28 / UI 队列新增“睡眠计算机”

Status: implemented and compile-verified. No live sleep execution was triggered during verification.

## 2026-06-28 / CR136 五倍 fast-exit stale exit 窄修 worker baseline

Status: Implemented and locally verified by CR136 repair worker. Scope was limited to stale
expected-combat exit generation/arming, WUBEI return-verification false-positive correction,
trusted `IN_COMBAT` state repair plus current-combat avatar baseline refresh, and focused guard.
No avatar ROI/threshold/15s grace/1s cadence, `BagService`, OCR/template/click/navigation, CR121
bounded wait, CR132 cache strategy, CR134, or CR135 business logic was changed.

Baseline before Java edits:

- Current branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
- Current HEAD: `2a97dd4309f4b14742cfcb741798d82d64fc230c`.
- Latest pushed/upstream baseline: `origin/codex/migrate-runner-dialog`
  = `3f0a2e79007121c98a15ad90d5ed7b8902033068`.
- `git status --short --branch` shows the worktree is already heavily dirty and ahead 1. This pass
  must not revert unrelated CR120-CR135, UI, OCR, update, image/template, config, or debug work.
- Relevant baseline/diff evidence checked before editing:
  - `git diff --stat @{u} -- src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/BattleRadarService.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/AutoCombatService.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java docs/ACTIVE_WORK.md docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md docs/cr-dashboard-data.js`
    shows all three touched Java files already differ heavily from pushed baseline due local CR109/CR113/CR121/CR132/CR134/CR135 work.
  - `git diff -- src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/BattleRadarService.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/AutoCombatService.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java`
    was inspected for current local fast expected-exit, pending exit, and return-home correction paths.
  - `git show @{u}:src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/BattleRadarService.java` confirms pushed
    baseline had only boolean `combatExitPending`; current local CR113/CR121 added avatar fast-exit
    fields but still no current-combat generation fence.
  - `git show @{u}:src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/AutoCombatService.java` confirms pushed
    baseline consumed `combatExitPending` directly after `checkAndSyncCombatState()`; current local
    CR109/CR113/CR121 added `FAST_EXPECTED_EXIT` and dynamic wake, but stale exit consumption is still
    guarded only by current `ActionState`.
  - `git show @{u}:src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java` confirms pushed baseline
    used simple two-attempt return item verification without the current trusted-combat correction;
    current local CR121 correction returns to `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH`, but it runs only after the
    two-attempt helper finishes.

Initial root-cause hypothesis:

- A previous combat can leave `combatExitPending=true` while the next WUBEI prepared enter-battle
  click has been consumed but the full radar has not yet observed the new combat entry. Because the
  pending exit has no generation/armed-after-enter fence, `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` can consume the stale
  exit as if the new expected combat already ended.
- `useReturnItem(...)` treats a cached return click that does not verify 宝象国 as a cache miss and
  falls through to a full task-page item scan, so the trusted `IN_COMBAT` correction is delayed until
  after multiple return-item attempts.
- `correctExpectedReturnFailureIfStillInCombat(...)` returns to `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH`, but it does
  not explicitly replace the fast expected-exit avatar baseline with the current in-combat frame
  after the trusted `IN_COMBAT` correction. The next avatar diff should remain enabled, but it must
  compare against the refreshed in-combat baseline rather than any stale or false-exit frame.

Implementation:

- `BattleRadarService` now arms expected-combat waits with `expectedCombatExitWaitArmedAtMs` and
  records `combatExitPendingAtMs` when a radar exit is published. `consumeCombatExitSignalForExpectedWait(...)`
  rejects and clears pending exits older than the current expected wait, so a fresh WUBEI
  `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` cannot consume the previous combat's stale exit signal.
- `AutoCombatService` arms the expected-combat wait once for `FAST_EXPECTED_EXIT`, consumes pending
  exit signals through the new armed-wait fence, and exposes
  `refreshFastExpectedExitBaselineAfterTrustedInCombat(...)` for the WUBEI correction path.
- `WubeiTask` now treats a cached or full-scan return item click that fails to verify `宝象国` as the
  one actual return-item use for the current false fast-exit correction episode. It immediately runs
  the trusted read-only combat probe instead of falling through to full scan or a second attempt in
  that same episode.
- If that trusted probe reports `IN_COMBAT`, WUBEI clears the pending team-return precheck, refreshes
  the current in-combat avatar baseline, and returns to `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH`. Avatar fast-exit remains
  enabled; a later fast-exit starts a new correction episode with a fresh one-use budget.
- If a return item was actually used but trusted probe says not in combat, WUBEI ends the current
  return-home episode through the existing failure path instead of spending another return-item use.
- Added focused guard `WubeiCR136FastExitLifecycleWiringTest` for stale pending-exit fencing,
  per-correction-episode one-use return semantics, trusted `IN_COMBAT` baseline refresh, and the
  requirement that same-combat avatar fast-exit is not disabled/degraded/invalidated.
- Xiuluo risk check: 修罗 also reaches expected combat through `AutoCombatService.PostCombatRecoveryPolicy.FAST_EXPECTED_EXIT`,

Status: source repair implemented; focused guard passed; fresh runtime pending. No `BagService`,
OCR/template threshold, click-coordinate, navigation, Xiuluo, or normal WUBEI combat cache logic was

User-approved direction update:

- The previous quick repair direction was too conservative: "disable WUBEI probe prescan/cache and
  always fall back to full scan."
- Corrected direction: 白龙马/显形镜任务 should still prescan, but it should prescan
  `bag/wubei_probe_item.png` (显形镜) instead of `bag/wubei_return_item.png`.
- Reason: 显形镜 occupies a task-page slot during 白龙马/probe. After the probe task completes,
  显形镜 disappears, so the return item is expected to shift into the old 显形镜 slot. Using the
  cached 显形镜 click point can therefore be the fastest return path for this branch.

Implemented boundary for the CR132 repair pass:

- In WUBEI probe runtime, the probe/mirror cache must be learned before 显形镜 is used. The primary
  hook is the tracker-green / probe path opportunity, using
  `PROBE_ITEM_TEMPLATE = "bag/wubei_probe_item.png"` when the current tracker label is
  `first-probe` or `second-probe`.
- Do not rely on a later combat-random probe for 白龙马, because the mirror may already have been
  consumed and removed before combat.
- User reconfirmed this boundary on 2026-06-28: 白龙马/显形镜不能在战斗中查看显形镜槽位。
  显形镜槽位必须在战斗前缓存，允许的 first version timing 是 tracker 绿字点击后
  `AFTER_TRACKER_GREEN`，或以后单独证明安全的移动中后台预扫；进入战斗后只允许跳过并
  使用已有显形镜槽位缓存。
- In WUBEI probe `RETURN_HOME`, consume the probe-item cache point as the predicted return-item
  click point, then verify the start map is `宝象国`.
- If the cache is absent, stale, click/use fails, or return verification does not reach `宝象国`,
  keep the existing full main-bag task-page return-item search as the final fallback.
- Ordinary WUBEI combat, 黄袍, 修罗, and non-probe cache paths still use their existing return item
  templates and behavior.
- Do not implement a row/column slot-shift table in this pass, and do not change generic
  `BagService` scan semantics, OCR/template thresholds, click coordinates, navigation, or
  白龙马 `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY` business branching.

    thread interruption; it has no pause/stop control wake primitive.
  - Current local `WindowReadyEventBus` already contains CR92 bounded/negative wait support and

    It still loops after a plain `notifyAll()` unless a matching business event exists.

    and marks/logs pause; it does not notify `WindowReadyEventBus` or interrupt the task thread.
  - Current local `WindowTaskRunner.stopCurrentTask()` requests stop and force-cancels the future, but
    there is still no explicit ready-event control wake log tying stop to the parked wait.
  - Current 修罗/五倍 park consumers call `TaskCheckpoint.throwIfStopRequested(...)` only after
    `WindowReadyEventBus.await(...)` returns; pause compensation therefore starts too late if the
    await remains asleep.
- Fresh failure evidence:
  - `2026-06-27 21:36:45.324` leader `hwnd-17240550` entered
    `WAIT_TARGET_PATHING_TERMINAL` via `WindowReadyEventBus.await(...)`
    with `wakeTypes=[PREPARED_ACTION_READY, PATHING_TERMINAL] timeoutMs=-1 afterSequence=0`.
  - `21:36:49.846` user pause was requested for all 5 修罗 windows.
  - Member windows reached `TaskPauseToken` checkpoint in `21:36:49.890 - 21:36:50.476`.
  - The leader did not checkpoint until `21:39:32.593`, after
    `WindowReadyEventBus.await result=timeout ... timeoutMs=167268 elapsedMs=167269`.
- Root boundary:
  - Existing CR92 source compensation only applies after ready-event wait returns.
  - The missing layer is that pause/stop does not wake the current ready-event park, so the task
    thread can stay asleep until timeout before it ever reaches `TaskPauseToken`.
- Repair direction:
  - Add a pause/stop wake path from `WindowTaskRunner` / task pause request into
    `WindowReadyEventBus` or the current park primitive.
  - `WindowReadyEventBus.await` should log a distinct pause wake result; task code must treat it
    only as a checkpoint opportunity, not as pathing/dialog/combat business truth.
  - Preserve CR92 timer compensation after return and do not change 修罗 180s / 五倍 timer values,
    navigation, OCR/template matching, click coordinates, or maintenance business rules.
- Implementation:
  - `WindowReadyEventBus` now has per-window control wakes:
    `wakeForTaskPause(windowId, reason)` and `wakeForTaskStop(windowId, reason)`.
  - All three ready-event wait paths poll the control wake before and after `monitor.wait(...)`.
    A control wake logs `window.ready.await result=pause-wake` or `result=stop-wake`, returns
    `Optional.empty()`, and does not publish any `WindowReadyEventType` business fact.
  - Control wakes share the bus sequence and are consumed once so old pause/stop signals do not make
    later low-afterSequence waits spin.
  - `WindowTaskRunner.pauseCurrentTask()` sets `TaskPauseToken` then calls
    `windowReadyEventBus.wakeForTaskPause(...)`.
  - `WindowTaskRunner.stopCurrentTask()` keeps the existing stop/interrupt/cancel path and also calls
    `windowReadyEventBus.wakeForTaskStop(...)` for explicit wait-layer diagnostics.
  - 修罗/五倍 task code was intentionally left on the existing path: control wake returns empty, then
    `TaskCheckpoint.throwIfStopRequested(...)` blocks/resumes and the existing
    `pauseBlockedMs` compensation adjusts timers.

    ready-event wake and before the existing break/return-null path, so `pause-wake` cannot be
    consumed as ordinary "prepared dialog not ready" evidence.

### Codex - 2026-06-27 / CR128 background startup probe repair

Status: CR128 background-first startup repair patched; source guard/compile passed; fresh runtime pending.

- User feedback:
  - The previous CR direction was wrong for multi-window startup.
  - Validated Alt+5/Alt+6 behavior is background HWND shortcut + background screenshot confirmation,
    so five windows can do this concurrently.
  - 五环 still must run every startup guard: Alt+1 map options, Alt+U expand/flying, Alt+5, and Alt+6.
  - These checks must be background-first and concurrent-friendly, not foreground per-window checking.
  - Foreground click correction is allowed only when a background probe clearly detects a wrong option.
  - If a 五环 queue is configured for two rounds, startup UI checks run once for that accepted queue,
    not once per round.
  - Left-top status / map / flying / minimap option checks must first be background-probed and stored
    as pending; only when that window later owns a safe foreground/input turn should it click
    immediately.
- Baseline before this repair:
  - Current branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
  - Current HEAD: `2a97dd4309f4b14742cfcb741798d82d64fc230c`.
  - Upstream: `origin/codex/migrate-runner-dialog` =
    `3f0a2e79007121c98a15ad90d5ed7b8902033068`.
  - `git status --short --branch` is heavily dirty before this work. This repair must not revert
    unrelated local edits.
- Evidence found:
  - `DefaultWindowTaskStartupInitializer.beforeTask(...)` applied `LeftTopStatusSwitchService` before
    task-specific startup branching; because `LeftTopStatusSwitchService.isSupportedTaskCode(...)`
    includes `wuhuan_v2`, 五环 leader startup could detect and click immediately.
  - With `bot.dhxy.task-startup-preparation-enabled=true`, the 五环 branch called
    `TaskStartupWindowPreparationService.prepareTaskStartupWindow()`.
  - `prepareTaskStartupWindow()` uses `InputSequences.submitExclusiveAndWait(...)` and direct
    foreground input to open/check/click Alt+1 map options and Alt+U expand/flying state before
    finally calling the background Alt+5/Alt+6 visibility method.
  - `GameClientTracker.captureToFile/captureToMemory` are HWND-first for screenshots, so the capture
    provider is not the core bug. The bug is putting click-needed startup checks in foreground
    per-window initialization.
  - The old CR107 card is historical and remains about 修罗/五倍. The latest 五环 requirement is now
    tracked separately by CR128.
- Source repair:
  - 五环 startup now calls `prepareTaskStartupWindowBackgroundFirst()` instead of directly calling the
    foreground `prepareTaskStartupWindow()`.
  - `prepareTaskStartupWindowBackgroundFirst()` uses background HWND Alt+1 / Alt+U plus screenshot
    probes for map options and expand/flying state. If everything is already correct, it closes the
    panels in the background and continues to background Alt+5 / Alt+6 visibility checks.
  - Only when a background probe sees an unchecked/checked state that needs a real checkbox click does
    it fall back to the old foreground `prepareTaskStartupWindow()` correction transaction.
  - Alt+U is now enabled for background HWND startup probing.
  - 五环 left-top startup now uses the no-click background probe/pending path instead of immediate
    leader startup click.
  - `WindowRuntimeContext` now keeps a queue-scoped startup-preparation marker. `WindowTaskRunner`
    clears it at task queue start; 五环 marks it after the first startup-prep attempt so a two-round
    queue does not repeat startup UI checks on the second round.
- Documentation:
  - Kept CR107 as the old Done card.
  - Added CR128 for the latest architecture repair: background probe + per-window pending consume for
    left-top/map/flying/minimap startup UI guards.
- Verification:
  - `node scripts/generate-cr-dashboard-data.js`
  - `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile`
  - `mvn -q -DskipTests "-Dexec.classpathScope=test" "-Dexec.mainClass=com.bot.dhxy.service.LeftTopStatusSwitchWiringTest" exec:java`

### Codex - 2026-06-27 / CR123 remote case upload design

Status: Worker/R2 upload slice implemented; local contract passed with patched CR124 JSON; Java uploader and real Cloudflare/R2 validation pending.

- User goal:
  - When another user runs DHXY locally and hits a failed/very slow task round, the local app should
    preserve a small diagnostic case and upload it so the maintainer can analyze the problem without
    receiving the full `logs/dhxy-console.log`.
  - First version should upload structured `case.json`, not a zip. Screenshots/marked images are
    deferred to an optional attachment mechanism.
- Existing Cloudflare context:
  - `D:/mavenProject/dhxy-license-worker` is a Cloudflare Worker project, but it is Worker + D1 for
    license verification, not R2 object storage.
  - Its `wrangler.toml` only binds `[[d1_databases]] binding = "DB"` and has no `[[r2_buckets]]`.
  - DHXY already calls `https://dhxy-license-worker.yueyunfe.workers.dev` for `/api/license/*`.
- Design decision recorded:
  - Create a separate sibling project, proposed path `D:/mavenProject/dhxy-case-worker`.
  - Use Cloudflare Worker as the authenticated upload gateway and R2 as the case object store.
  - Do not put large diagnostic JSON/log bodies into the existing license D1 database.
  - Do not embed R2 credentials in the Java client.
- Created/updated docs:
  - `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`: added CR123 sprint row.
  - `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-27-remote-case-upload-design.md`: first design spec.
- Implementation:
  - Created sibling Worker project `D:/mavenProject/dhxy-case-worker`.
  - Added `POST /api/case/upload` in `src/index.js`.
  - The Worker validates:
    - upload token from `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `X-Case-Upload-Token`;
    - payload byte size using `MAX_CASE_BYTES`, defaulting to 2MB;
    - required case schema fields: `schemaVersion`, `caseId`, `createdAt`, `caseType`,
      `severity`, and task type from either `taskType` or `task.taskCode`;
    - license identifier from `licenseId`, `license.licenseId`, `license.id`, or
      `app.licenseId`.
  - The Worker stores valid case JSON in R2 under
    `cases/YYYY-MM-DD/<machineHash>/<taskCode>/<caseId>.case.json`.
  - It updates a lightweight date index at `indexes/YYYY-MM-DD.json`, with upsert semantics by
    `caseId`.
  - It supports the CR124 nested local-case shape, especially `task.taskCode`,
    `app.licenseId`, and `runtimeSnapshots.environment.machineHash`.
  - Added `wrangler.toml`, `package.json`, Node built-in tests, and `README.md`.

### Codex worker - 2026-06-26 / CR120 common-box 业务角色不再读取 runtime role

Status: Implemented; compile / test-compile / focused CR120 guards passed; fresh runtime pending.

Runtime blocker addressed:

- Fresh 修罗 runtime showed leader common-box safe hook could skip as `UNKNOWN` after several rounds.
- Root cause: `CommonBoxService` detection / consume used mutable `WindowRuntimeContext.getRole()` through
  `roleFor(window)` as the business truth. During the run this role can drift to `UNKNOWN` even though
  the task-start context still knows the window is the leader.

Implementation:

- `CommonBoxService.roleFor(...)` now derives `LEADER` / `MEMBER` only from
  `TaskExecutionContext.windowRole`.
- Detection / consume / `hasPendingBoxForCurrentWindow(...)` no longer use
  `WindowRuntimeContext.getRole()` to decide whether a common-box business hook may run.
- `WindowRuntimeContext` remains used for window binding validation: window id, hwnd/native binding,
  player identity epoch, and task-run key.
- `CommonBoxBoundaryBehaviorTest` now covers the actual runtime blocker: a pending leader box remains
  visible when runtime role drifts to `UNKNOWN` but task context role is `LEADER`; context role
  `UNKNOWN` still fails closed.
- No DialogService / AutoCombatService CR104 / broadcast logic was touched in this patch.

Implementation:

- `AutoCombatService.maybeRunCombatMaintenance(...)` keeps the 4s
  `PanelVerifyMode.ENTRY_MAINTENANCE` verify-only behavior, but no longer returns before the
  optional refresh branch. Entry maintenance can no longer swallow a same-tick
  `LOW_ROUNDS` / `REFRESH_DUE` refresh check.
- The optional refresh branch now computes `RoundsRefreshReason` first. `LOW_ROUNDS` and `UNKNOWN`
  can enter the existing `VERIFY_AND_REFRESH` path immediately instead of waiting for
  `lastAutoBattleRefreshAt + refreshIntervalMs`; `REFRESH_DUE` still uses the existing
  per-window and same-team gates.
- Added a per-window urgent-rounds cooldown for `LOW_ROUNDS` / `UNKNOWN`, so a failed panel verify
  does not create a 900ms WAIT_COMBAT retry loop.
- `nextCombatMaintenanceDelayMs()` now treats cached `LOW_ROUNDS`, `UNKNOWN`, and due
  `REFRESH_DUE` as real maintenance wake deadlines, respecting the urgent and refresh-due retry
  guards.
- Updated `AutoCombatRefreshDuePanelVerifyGateTest` to guard the no-early-return shape and the
  urgent low/unknown retry field.

  `hwnd-2AD117C` repeatedly logged `auto-combat entry maintenance: clean generic windows and verify
  panel` plus `auto-combat panel rounds refresh skipped: source=entry-maintenance reason=verify-only`,

  still refreshed, e.g. `hwnd-4760FA6` at `19:23:30.759` with `reason=refresh-due`.

  `gameContext.getAutoCombatEstimatedRounds()`. If that cache still looked healthy while the visible
  panel had already fallen low, the leader skipped `VERIFY_AND_REFRESH` without ever calling

  verify-only pass. If the same tick sees a healthy cache, it consumes that one-shot flag by running
  `PanelVerifyMode.VERIFY_AND_REFRESH` once, so actual visible rounds can correct the stale cache.
- `AutoCombatPanelService.refreshAutoCombatRoundsIfNeeded(...)` now receives the already visible
  panel match and reads panel rounds before the healthy-cache skip. A successful read updates
  `gameContext.setAutoCombatEstimatedRounds(...)`; if the visible value is low, the existing Alt+8
  refresh path runs with `reason=low-rounds`. `REFRESH_DUE` still uses CR65's gates.

  `verifyAndRefreshReadsVisibleRoundsBeforeTrustingHealthyCache()`.

Context:

- CR116 came from the 修罗 stuck shape around `2026-06-25 12:53-12:59+`: after tracker green click,
  the leader could stay in `WAIT_TRACKER_SHORTCUT_PATHING` for more than six minutes because the
  180s pre-combat watchdog only ran when the phase loop regained control.
- Existing wait specs could pass `timeoutMs=-1` to `WindowReadyEventBus`; accept-time tracker and
  objective background futures also looped on `future.get(250ms)` without a total watchdog budget.

Implementation:

- Added CR116 source guard:
  - `src/test/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/xiuluo/XiuluoPreCombatWatchdogBoundedWaitWiringTest.java`
- In `XiuluoTaskV2.parkAfterYieldIfNeeded(...)`:
  - Compute `boundedTimeoutMs` from the remaining pre-combat watchdog budget.
  - Pass `boundedTimeoutMs` into both pathing-specific and generic `WindowReadyEventBus` waits.
  - If the budget is already exhausted before waiting, return a normal `FAILED` outcome.
  - If the bounded event wait times out and the compensated state has no remaining budget, return a
    normal `FAILED` outcome so the existing `restartRoundAfterPhaseFailure(...)` path reaccepts.
  - Logs now include raw `timeoutMs`, `boundedTimeoutMs`, pause compensation, wait reason, and source.
- Added central helpers in `XiuluoTaskV2`:
  - `remainingPreCombatWatchdogBudgetMs(...)`
  - `boundedPreCombatWaitTimeoutMs(...)`
  - `preCombatWatchdogTimeoutOutcome(...)`
- In `waitForAcceptTrackerPanelResult(...)` and `waitForBackgroundObjectiveResult(...)`:
  - Each 250ms future wait is capped to `min(250ms, remainingBudget)`.
  - If the budget reaches zero, tracker parse returns `TaskTrackerPanelReadResult.empty()` and
    objective parse returns `Optional.empty()`, preserving the existing shortcut fallback/objective
    recovery path.
  - Local pause compensation is applied while waiting so an intentional pause does not burn the
    future-wait budget.

  - Saved image:
    `images/temp/hwnd-3F50A4E/sheyaoxiang_status_green_digits.png`.

  - Pixel connected-component analysis of the same washed image found two digit blocks:

- Requirement clarified by user: do not merely block bad OCR; the system should automatically learn
  摄妖香 status digits from OCR when possible, collect `0-9`, and then use templates to read the full
  number.

  - Reads complete minute text from learned templates under
    `images/template/status/sheyaoxiang_digits/`.
  - Uses OCR only as a bootstrap label source.
  - If OCR returns a complete digit string whose length matches the segmented glyph count, each
    left-to-right glyph can be learned.
  - If OCR returns one digit, it learns only the glyph whose bounding box is actually covered by the
    OCR word box.
  - Once `0.png` through `9.png` exist in the template directory, learning stops.

  - writes the existing washed image as before;
  - runs local OCR as before;
  - calls the template reader to recognize or learn;
  - trusts template/complete OCR results for `remainingMinutes`;
  - treats multi-glyph + partial OCR as `green-digits-learning=N` instead of using the partial value.
- `PlayerStateService.ensureSheYaoXiang(...)` skips refill when the buff icon exists and the only
  missing piece is a multi-digit value still being learned. This prevents the observed `47 -> 7`
  partial OCR from triggering an unnecessary refill.

Status: Implemented locally / source guard and compile passed; runtime pending.

  `findAndUseItemFromBack(..., maxBagIndex=5)`, scanning current page and pages 6 -> 1,
  so a missing `bag/xiuluo_return_item.png` cost about 17.6s before normal accept flow.

  still keeps the existing `RETURN_ITEM_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS` retry policy, but each attempt now also
  checks only the main-bag task page instead of scanning all bag pages.

Implementation:

- `BagService.findAndUseMainBagTaskPageItem(...)` added a main-bag task-page-only item use path.
  It opens the bag, switches/scans `MAIN_BAG_TASK_TAB_INDEX`, clicks the matched item if present,
  then closes the bag. It deliberately does not call `pageScanOrder(...)` and does not scan normal
  bag pages.
- `XiuluoTaskV2.resolveStartupTrackerOrReturnItem(...)` no longer loops over
  `RETURN_ITEM_VERIFY_ATTEMPTS` when startup tracker detection misses.
- `XiuluoTaskV2.tryUseStartupReturnItemOnce(...)` now does exactly one lightweight
  `startup-return-item` probe through `findAndUseMainBagTaskPageItem(RETURN_ITEM_TEMPLATE, ...)`.
  If not found on the task page, it immediately falls back to normal
  `ACCEPT_TASK_NAVIGATE_TO_NPC`.
- `XiuluoTaskV2.useReturnItemAndVerifyStartMap(...)` now uses the same task-page-only bag path for
  修罗回旗. This prevents post-combat/unknown-combat return verification from scanning normal pages
  for a task item.

  maintenance delay remains `4000ms`.

Evidence / root cause:

  maintenance was scheduled but often never ran.
- `14:17:47.747` battle 34 entered combat and scheduled entry maintenance after `4000ms`; 修罗 then
  parked on `WAIT_COMBAT_STATE_CHANGE timeoutMs=-1` and did not wake until combat exit at
  `14:18:22.980`, so the 4s cleanup/panel maintenance was skipped.
- `14:19:40.009` battle 35 scheduled the same 4s maintenance; a later `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED` event
  happened to wake the task at `14:19:47.956`, then `14:19:48.117` entry maintenance ran and
  `14:19:50.057` clicked the `x2` close button on the correct leader window.

  `timeoutMs=-1`, then no maintenance wake happened before combat exit at `14:23:05.300`.
- Root cause: `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED` is edge/event driven, not periodic. 修罗 `WAIT_COMBAT` parks
  indefinitely on that event, so `AutoCombatService.pendingCombatEntryMaintenanceAt`,
  40s generic UI cleanup, and configured auto-combat refresh are not real wakeups for the leader
  task unless another combat-state event happens after they become due.

Implementation plan:

- Add a focused guard that 修罗 `WAIT_COMBAT_STATE_CHANGE` must use a bounded maintenance wake timeout
  derived from `AutoCombatService`, rather than the old direct `-1` wait.
- Add `AutoCombatService.nextCombatMaintenanceDelayMs()` for the current bound window. It reports
  the next due combat-entry cleanup, sparse generic UI cleanup, or configured panel refresh.
- Keep the event wait on `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED`, but bound its timeout so the task wakes near the
  next due maintenance; cap longer waits to a sparse maintenance probe window instead of restoring
  the old 900ms churn.
- Add a focused guard and log for `UICleanerService.findGenericCloseButtonPoint(...)` when no
  generic close button matches, so future runs can distinguish "cleanup did scan but no x button"
  from "cleanup never ran".

Implementation:

  due combat maintenance deadline:

  - sparse 40s generic UI cleanup;

- `XiuluoTaskV2.waitForCombatStateWake(...)` still waits on `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED`, but no longer
  parks indefinitely. It uses `combatMaintenanceWakeTimeoutMs()`:
  - near due maintenance: wake at the due delay, with a `500ms` minimum to avoid zero-timeout churn;
  - long/no immediate due maintenance: cap at `10000ms`, so long fights still tick maintenance

- `git status --short --branch` is already very dirty before CR100 implementation. Relevant CR100
  paths already dirty before this pass include `InputActionQueue.java`, `InputActionRequest.java`,
  and `InputActionWorker.java`; `InputActionScope.java` has no local diff at this baseline point.
- Relevant local diff evidence before this pass: `InputActionQueue` already refreshes/validates the
  live native binding before constructing `InputActionRequest`; `InputActionRequest` already captures
  `playerIdentityEpoch`; `InputActionWorker` already has player-identity-epoch gates and Alt shortcut
  terminal-failure handling. None of this pre-existing input plumbing captures task pause state.

Context:

- User reported a pause request reached task checkpoints, but an already-submitted
  `npcClick:taskTooltipTemplate#1` input sequence still continued through click.
- Local source inspection confirms `InputActionRequest` currently captures window context and player
  identity epoch only; `InputActionWorker` checks request cancellation, thread interruption, and
  identity epoch before actions, but not the submitting task pause token.
- `TaskExecutionContextHolder` has the current task context only on the submitting task thread, so
  the pause token must be captured at `InputActionQueue` submission time rather than read from the
  worker thread.

Published:

- Added Sprint Board row `CR100` in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Added detailed card `Card CR100: pause-aware input request cancellation`.

Scope for worker:

- Implement CR100 only in `InputActionQueue`, `InputActionRequest`, `InputActionWorker`,
  `InputActionScope`, and focused tests/source guards.
- Do not change NPC click, navigation, coordinates, OCR/template matching, task phases, or business
  pause checkpoint behavior.

Implementation:

- Added `TaskExecutionContextHolder` to `InputActionQueue` and capture the current
  `TaskPauseToken` at request submission time for both action-list and exclusive-callback requests.
- Added a captured `TaskPauseToken` to `InputActionRequest`, with `getPauseToken()` and
  `isPauseRequested()`; cancellation checks now treat a paused captured token as cancel-like.
- `InputActionRequest.cancel(reason)` now stores the first cancellation reason, and
  `InputActionDeadLetter` prints it when no exception exists. Pause abort diagnostics therefore show
  the exact stage, e.g. `reason=task-paused:action-2`, instead of a generic `unknown`.
- Updated `InputActionWorker` to check pause before focus/input transaction, before action-list
  execution, before each action, and before exclusive callbacks. A paused request is completed
  `false`, logged with window id / description / stage, and moved to dead letter without waiting for
  resume.
- Updated `InputActionScope.isCancelled()` so long exclusive/direct-input callbacks that poll the
  scope also stop when the captured request pause token is paused.
- Added `InputActionPauseCancellationGuardTest` to prove queue capture, scope polling, worker stage
  wiring, and a direct behavior case where `MOVE_MOUSE` requests pause and the later
  `SLEEP -> CLICK_LEFT` steps do not run.
- Updated `WindowIdentityDriftP2WiringTest` for the new four-argument `InputActionRequest`
  construction while preserving the existing CR95 checks.

  future is already complete.

  registers the shortcut intent as `WindowPathingIntentType.TARGETED` with
  `targetMapName=objective.getMapName()` and `targetX/targetY=null`; if absent, it preserves the old
  `UNTARGETED_TRACKER` behavior.

  it closes the team window with `xiuluo-v2:shortcut-target-map-arrived`, clears the consumed pathing
  signal, and parks for prepared enter-battle/combat. Untargeted terminal states keep the existing
  re-read/re-click behavior. `shortcut-enter-battle-prepared` remains a fallback close source.

  objective future is not ready at the green-click instant, `attachShortcutTargetMapUpgrade(...)`
  attaches to that future and calls `upgradeActivePathingIntentTargetMap(...)` for the exact active

  `GetWindowRect(...)`; `WindowNativeBinding.withGeometry(...)` preserves stale title/class/process;

Plan:

- Add source tests for live title refresh, same-HWND title/player drift, geometry-only refresh, blank
  live title, and lazy invalidation of player-scoped maintenance caches.
- Refresh live title/class/process together with geometry. Blank live titles are carried to runtime
  commit so the currently committed binding, not a stale caller binding, decides preservation.
- Let `WindowRuntimeContext` detect same-HWND player/title drift, update `GameContext.State.me`, clear
  stale dialog/pathing/prepared state, and bump a player-identity epoch.
- Make per-window player caches compare that epoch and reset themselves before reuse.

Implemented:

- `WindowNativeBindingRefreshService.refreshGeometry(...)` now refreshes live title/class/process
  together with geometry through a testable native probe. After Cbank feedback, transient blank live
  titles are no longer folded into a caller-side stale title before runtime commit.
- `WindowRuntimeContext.setNativeBinding(...)` now detects same-HWND player/title drift, updates
  `GameContext.State.me`, clears stale visible dialog / dialog interest / dialog preparation /
  prepared action / pathing / pending route memories, and increments `playerIdentityEpoch`.
- `GameClientTracker`, `MultiWindowTaskManager`, and `TaskWindowRuntimeService` now write each valid
  refreshed binding back to `WindowRuntimeContext`, so same-geometry title drift is observable.
- `TaskMaintenanceService` 三技能 state and `PlayerStateService` player runtime state now compare
  `playerIdentityEpoch` and lazily reset stale per-player window caches before reuse. After Cbank
  feedback, 三技能 resolves epoch-scoped state before reading `lastSummonSkillCleanAtByWindow`, so a
  new player cannot inherit the previous player's 20-minute cooldown.
- `ClientIdentityService` now uses the same `WindowTitleIdentityParser` as the drift guard.
- Cbank P2 follow-up:
  - `InputActionQueue`, `WindowAwareInputCoordinator`, and `BoundWindowKeyboardService` refresh and
    commit the live native binding before pure input/focus/HWND-keyboard actions, so input-only
    paths can observe same-HWND account drift before the next screenshot/tracker refresh.
  - `TeamRoleDetectionService.resolveCurrentPlayerId(...)` now prefers the current runtime binding
    title over the task-start `TaskExecutionContext.nativeWindowTitle`.
  - `AutoCombatService` runtime state now records `playerIdentityEpoch` and resets pending
    combat-entry / follower first-aid pressure when the same window id belongs to a new player.
- Codex re-review P1 follow-up: `WindowRuntimeContext.setNativeBinding(...)` is now synchronized, so
  reading the current binding, preserving transient blank titles, detecting drift, clearing stale
  player-scoped state, incrementing epoch, and assigning the new binding happen in one atomic commit.
- Lagrange/Codex P1 stale-nonblank follow-up: added
  `WindowNativeBindingRefreshService.refreshAndCommit(...)`, which performs live native refresh and
  runtime binding commit inside the same runtime-context monitor. Production runtime paths now use this
  method instead of capturing a live snapshot and committing it later from the caller.
- Lagrange/Codex P1 input-epoch follow-up: `InputActionRequest` now captures request-time
  `playerIdentityEpoch`, and `InputActionWorker` cancels old-epoch queued input before focus,
  before exclusive callbacks, and before each action.
