  epoch mismatch clears old cooldown maps. `TaskMaintenanceSummonSkillEpochCooldownTest` covers
  old-player cooldown not blocking the new player.
- P2: pure input paths still use cached binding without live title refresh (`InputActionQueue`,
  `WindowAwareInputCoordinator`, `BoundWindowKeyboardService`). If the next action after drift is an
  Alt/key/mouse input instead of a capture/tracker path, logs and guard can remain stale until a later
  refresh path. Fixed by Cbank P2 follow-up: all three pure input paths refresh/commit live binding
  before submitting or sending input.
- P2: `TeamRoleDetectionService.resolveCurrentPlayerId(...)` prefers the task-start
  `TaskExecutionContext.nativeWindowTitle` over current runtime binding. After runtime title refresh, role
  detection can still compare the old player id unless this priority is reversed. Fixed by Cbank P2
  follow-up: runtime binding title is now first.
- P2 fixed by Tangde follow-up: `ClientIdentityService` and `TeamRoleDetectionService` refresh/commit
  the current runtime binding before reading current title/player id.
- P2: `AutoCombatService` pending first-aid / combat-entry maintenance state remains keyed only by
  windowId. Add `playerIdentityEpoch` to avoid stale player maintenance pressure after same-HWND account
  drift. Fixed by Cbank P2 follow-up: state resets on epoch mismatch.
- P2/test gap: `WindowRuntimeBindingCommitSynchronizationTest`,
  `WindowIdentityDriftCacheInvalidationWiringTest`, and `WindowIdentityDriftP2WiringTest` are
  source-string coverage, not full behavior coverage. Current coverage includes blank-title signal
  preservation, drift-before-cooldown behavior, synchronized binding-commit guard, and P2 wiring guards,
  but still needs fuller behavior tests for background HWND shortcut epoch rejection with no real-input
  fallback, failed-live-refresh fail-closed behavior, identity sync live-title priority,
  runtime-binding-first role-id resolution, and any future direct non-runtime refresh path.
- P3 from Jason: `GameClientTracker.useBoundWindowIfAvailable(...)` now reads committed runtime binding,
  so preserved titles are safe; if the committed binding itself is blank, fallback consumers can still
  see `hwnd-*` as a pseudo title. Prefer preserving a previous parseable tracker title or failing closed.

- Keep `BUSINESS_OPTION_CLICKED`, `FAILED`, `INTERRUPTED`, formal/leader fallback-enabled maintenance, OPTION fallback, templates, click coordinates, OCR, navigation, WUBEI, 五环, and 修罗 phases unchanged.

Implementation:

- Lightweight maintenance broadcast probes (`CLICK_BUSINESS_OPTION`, `includeCleanupBusinessOptions=false`,

  `BUSINESS_OPTION_NOT_FOUND`, `DialogType.NONE`, `clicked=false`, fallback disabled.

  DEBUG with `dialog handle result suppressed by lightweight no-action policy`.

Status: Review: source/test/compile passed; fresh runtime pending. 用户批准直接修 CR65。本轮处理 fresh 修罗 runtime 里仍出现的
`auto-combat panel: verify and align` / `auto-combat panel rounds refresh by Alt+8` / team-burst defer 噪声。

Baseline before edit:

- Branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
- HEAD: `2a97dd4`.
- `git status --short` was already very dirty before this edit; unrelated Java/docs/config/log/testcase files are left untouched.
- Relevant current CR65 implementation before this edit:
  - `AutoCombatService.maybeRunCombatMaintenance(...)` already has a pre-verify gate for optional `refresh-due` checks.
  - That gate runs only in the optional periodic refresh branch.
  - The combat-entry maintenance branch still calls `autoCombatPanelService.verifyAndAlignPanel(context)` directly.
  - `AutoCombatPanelService.verifyAndAlignPanel(...)` currently combines three concerns: panel visibility, panel alignment, and remaining-round refresh via `refreshAutoCombatRoundsIfNeeded(...)`.

Fresh runtime root cause:

- `docs/run-reports/2026-06-22-xiuluo-run-observation.md` range `18:24:18.886-18:29:48.647` still had
  `verify and align=13`, `Alt+8 rounds refresh=5`, and inner burst defers.
- Cutting each verify line against nearby logs shows the majority were not from the optional refresh branch:
  - e.g. `18:25:57.765`, `18:25:58.163`, `18:25:59.476`, `18:26:01.043`, `18:26:01.162`,
    `18:28:03.929`, `18:28:05.593`, `18:28:05.922`, `18:28:07.629` are
    `auto-combat entry maintenance: clean generic windows and verify panel`.
  - Those entry-maintenance calls then run `verifyAndAlignPanel(...)`, which reaches
    `refreshAutoCombatRoundsIfNeeded("verify", context)` and can still issue `reason=unknown`,
    `reason=refresh-due`, or inner `team burst guard` logs.
- Root cause: entry maintenance uses the same compound verify method as the periodic refresh path,
  so it bypasses the CR65 pre-verify gate and pays the round-refresh work even when this entry tick
  only needed panel visibility/alignment.

Planned scope:

- Split panel verification mode narrowly so entry maintenance can verify/align the panel without
  refreshing remaining rounds.
- Keep periodic optional refresh behavior unchanged: healthy cache skip, refresh-due pre-gate,
  low-rounds / unknown immediate refresh, and existing `Alt+8` behavior all remain in the periodic
  branch.
- Do not change battle radar, dialog fallback, maintenance broadcast matching, click coordinates,
  OCR/template thresholds, WUBEI, 五环, or 修罗 task phase semantics.

Implementation:

- `VERIFY_AND_REFRESH` preserves the previous periodic behavior: verify visible panel, align if needed,
  then refresh remaining rounds through the existing low-rounds / unknown / refresh-due policy.
- `ENTRY_MAINTENANCE` verifies/aligns the panel only and logs
  `auto-combat panel rounds refresh skipped: source=entry-maintenance reason=verify-only`; it never
  calls `refreshAutoCombatRoundsIfNeeded(...)`.
- `AutoCombatService` combat-entry maintenance now calls `ENTRY_MAINTENANCE` and no longer updates
  `lastAutoBattleRefreshAt`, because no real `Alt+8` refresh happened in that branch.
- The periodic optional refresh branch now calls `VERIFY_AND_REFRESH`, keeping the previous CR65

### Codex - 2026-06-22 / CR74 intent-replaced mixed-runtime follow-up

Status: In Progress. 用户要求继续 CR74，先弄清楚为什么部分 world-map route-result memory 已经可用，而部分仍被 `intent-replaced`。

Baseline before edit:

- Branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
- HEAD: `2a97dd4 Document world map route result memory design`.
- `git status --short` was already very dirty before this edit; unrelated modified/untracked Java/docs/config/log/testcase files are left untouched.
- Relevant existing guard: `NavigationWorldMapRouteMemoryIntentOwnershipTest` only protected the direct `submitWorldMapSearchAndClickDestination(...) -> PATHING_STARTED` branch.

Fresh runtime evidence:

- Positive examples prove the first CR74 repair partly works:
  - `2026-06-22 13:05:56.585` `[world-map-route-memory] fast path used: fromMap=灵兽村 targetMap=凤巢五层`.
  - `2026-06-22 14:19:05.203` `[world-map-route-memory] fast path used: fromMap=灵兽村 targetMap=白骨山`.
  - Multiple `pending success` lines now reach `clean=true` and later `usedMemory=true`.
- Negative examples still reproduce the remaining bug:
  - `2026-06-22 13:26:40.516` created pending for `灵兽村 -> 洛阳城` with `intentId=0f5aaf9b...`.
  - `2026-06-22 13:26:55.627` registered a second `navigateToMap` intent for the same target with source `same target route already submitted; watcher will confirm pathing`.
  - `2026-06-22 13:27:00.515` abandoned the original pending as `reason=intent-replaced`.
  - Similar replace examples appear for `兰若寺`, `四圣庄`, `万寿山`, `长安`, `蟠桃园`, and later `洛阳城`.

Root cause:

- The first CR74 patch only covered the immediate successful world-map submit branch.
- Remaining replace cases come from later `navigateToMap(...)` re-entry while the same route leg is already active:
  - `pathing-active-gate` returns `PATHING_STARTED` with message `same target route already submitted; watcher will confirm pathing`;
  - `routeDialogGateBeforeWorldMap(...)` returns `PATHING_STARTED` with message `same target route already submitted before world-map search; watcher will confirm pathing`;
  - prepared route-dialog click branches can also return `PATHING_STARTED` while the old active same-target intent still owns the route leg.
- Those branches did not set `pathingIntentAlreadyActive` / `pathingIntentOwnedByNestedRoute`, so the `finally` block still registered an outer duplicate `navigateToMap` intent. `WindowTaskRunner.settlePendingWorldMapRouteResultMemory(...)` then correctly treated the old pending intent id as replaced.

Implementation:

- `NavigationService.navigateToMap(...)` now marks `pathingIntentAlreadyActive` when a same-target active intent already owns a `PATHING_STARTED` result from:
  - prepared route-dialog priority click;
  - fresh same-target route pending in the pathing-active gate;
  - `routeDialogGateBeforeWorldMap(...)` returning `PATHING_STARTED`.
- This keeps the existing `intent-replaced` abandon behavior for a real second navigation, but avoids replacing the same route leg with a duplicate outer intent.
- Extended `NavigationWorldMapRouteMemoryIntentOwnershipTest` so future patches must protect both the direct submit branch and the same-target/gate re-entry branches.

Verification:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile; java -cp "target/test-classes;target/classes" com.bot.dhxy.service.NavigationWorldMapRouteMemoryIntentOwnershipTest` passed.
- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed.

Fresh runtime still needed:

- Repeated 修罗 route runs should show these same-target re-entry cases no longer produce immediate `intent-replaced`.
- Successful arrivals should keep increasing consecutive success and produce `fast path used`.

Status: investigation only; no Java/OCR/template/click/navigation code changed. User asked why the paused-before round did not try AutoJ/Alt+A after failing to click 修罗.

Evidence from `logs/dhxy-console.log` around `2026-06-21 23:00:29-23:03:04`:
- Round 11 reached target `龙窟七层(49,1)` and entered `CLICK_TARGET_NPC`.
- The normal target click pipeline failed: task tooltip not found, yellow OCR had no candidates, player anchor was null, Ctrl menu origins were empty, and recovered `看打` dialog/template checks returned `NONE`.
- Direct-combat fallback was attempted as a preflight, but every attempt stopped before pressing Alt+A because `GameStateUtil.detectFlyingState(...)` returned `UNKNOWN`.
- Repeated examples: `23:00:39`, `23:00:56`, `23:01:17`, `23:02:18`, `23:02:43`, and `23:02:54` all log `NPC direct-combat preflight flying state ... state=UNKNOWN` followed by `NPC direct-combat skipped because flying state is unknown`.

Current implementation detail:
- `detectFlyingState(...)` presses `Alt+U`, waits `350ms`, then searches only the fixed window-relative rect `(692,521)-(751,549)` for `images/template/status/flying.png` (`降落`) and `images/template/status/unflying.png` (`飞行`) at match rate `0.84`.
- It toggles `Alt+U` closed in `finally`, but it does not save the opened-panel screenshot/crop. The latest `latest_vision.png` is after the panel was closed, so the failure screenshot is not available.
- Correction: the marked `latest_vision` image is not an Alt+U status-panel screenshot; it is a later post-failure navigation/return image and must not be used as evidence for what the opened status panel looked like. It only illustrates the fixed screen region that the current code would inspect.
- Current `latest_vision` marked/cropped for the probe rectangle was saved only as a coordinate reference:
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_probe_latest_marked.png`
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_probe_latest_crop.png`
- User manually opened the real Alt+U status panel and a fresh screenshot was captured without sending keys:
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_manual_altu_full_20260621_231633_681.png`
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_manual_altu_marked_20260621_231633_681.png`
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_manual_altu_crop_20260621_231633_681.png`
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_manual_altu_summary_20260621_231633_681.json`
- The fresh manual Alt+U image proves the fixed rect is wrong for this live layout: it lands on the bottom-right page/arrow button of the flight panel, not on the `飞行` / `降落` button. Template scores are therefore very low (`flying=0.2479`, `unflying=0.1461`, threshold `0.84`), so the current detector will correctly return `UNKNOWN` even when the panel is actually open.

Conclusion:
- This is a CR73 blocker, not a missing fallback call. The code reaches the direct-combat fallback, but the flying-state safety gate treats UNKNOWN as fatal and returns before `npcClick:directCombat:enterAltA`.
- Next code card should make the flying-state probe save debug evidence and recalibrate the inspected rect from the real Alt+U panel. Do not silently bypass UNKNOWN without user approval because CR73 intentionally added it as a global safety boundary before AutoA.

### Codex - 2026-06-21 / CR74 修罗 world-map route-result memory intent ownership investigation

Status: investigation + Sprint Board task publication only; no Java/business/OCR/template/click/navigation code changed. New card CR74 created in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

Required context read:

- `AGENTS.md` from the user-provided session context.

Commands / evidence:

- Count scan over current `logs/dhxy-console.log`:
  - `fast path used=0`
  - `[world-map-route-memory] pending created=36`
  - `[world-map-route-memory] pending success=0`
  - `[world-map-route-memory] pending abandoned=36`
  - `reason=intent-replaced=37`
  - `confirm pending world-map route memory=0`
  - `confirm pending route memory=10`
- Config scan over `config/world_map_route_result_memory.json`:
  - `entries=36`
  - `clean=0`
  - `successCountSum=0`
  - `consecutiveSuccessPositive=0`
- Source inspection:
  - `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/NavigationService.java`
  - `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/execution/WindowTaskRunner.java`
  - `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/WorldMapRouteResultMemoryService.java`

Root cause:

- 修罗 does create world-map route-result pending memory, but it is bound to the wrong short-lived pathing intent.
- `NavigationService.submitWorldMapSearchAndClickDestination(...)` registers `worldMapRouteClick`, then `rememberPendingWorldMapRouteResultClick(...)` stores that active intent id into the pending memory.
- The outer `navigateToMap(...)` `finally` block then registers a second same-leg `navigateToMap` intent for the same `PATHING_STARTED` result, because `pathingIntentOwnedByNestedRoute` is only set for the special 灵兽村/张闻 route, not for normal world-map result clicks.
- `WindowTaskRunner.settlePendingWorldMapRouteResultMemory(...)` compares `pending.intentId` with the current active pathing intent id and correctly records `intent-replaced` when they differ. In this case, however, the replacement is an internal duplicate same-leg registration, not a real second navigation.

Concrete fresh log chain:

- `2026-06-21 17:58:36.574`: pathing intent registered as `phase=worldMapRouteClick`, `intentId=fe99b331...`, target `兰若寺`.
- `2026-06-21 17:58:36.575`: `[world-map-route-memory] pending created ... intentId=fe99b331...`.
- Immediately after: outer `navigateToMap(...)` registers `phase=navigateToMap`, `intentId=c8cceacf...`, same target `兰若寺`.
- `2026-06-21 17:58:43.837`: pending is abandoned with `reason=intent-replaced`, `pendingIntentId=fe99b331... currentIntentId=c8cceacf...`.
- Later `confirm pending route memory` logs are route-dialog / transfer-choice memory, not `WorldMapRouteResultMemoryService.recordSuccess(...)`; they do not make route-result memory clean.

Sprint Board update:

- Published CR74: `Fix world-map route-result memory intent ownership so 修罗 can promote clean route memory`.
- CR74 scope is intent ownership only:
  - either prevent the duplicate outer same-leg pathing registration after `worldMapRouteClick`, or bind pending memory to the final active intent seen by settlement;
  - preserve `intent-replaced` abandon for genuine second navigations;
  - do not change world-map OCR/click/scroll algorithms, route-dialog choice memory, 修罗 business phases, WUBEI/五倍 semantics, or the route-result clean threshold (`consecutiveSuccessCount >= 5`).

Performance goal check:

- Current performance goal is still blocked for this subpath: route-result memory never reaches clean, so 修罗 keeps paying full world-map route-result OCR/template/scroll cost.

### Codex - 2026-06-21 / CR72 摄妖香内存信任窗口改为 50 分钟

Status: implemented; compile passed.

Context:

- User clarified that 摄妖香 memory-trust time should be 50 minutes. The 20-minute number is the
  remaining-time refill threshold after full status verification, not the cache validity window.
- `PlayerStateService` is shared by 五倍 and 修罗 leader 摄妖香 checks, so this is one global leader-task supply rule, not a 修罗-only rule.

Implementation:

- `PlayerStateService` now separates two concepts:
  - `INCENSE_MEMORY_TRUST_MS = 50 * 60 * 1000L`: if the program used 摄妖香 within the last 50 minutes, it may skip bag opening only after a lightweight status icon check proves the buff icon is present.
  - `INCENSE_REFRESH_REMAINING_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000L`: after the full status probe can read remaining time, only refill when remaining time is at or below 20 minutes.
- After memory age exceeds 50 minutes, the code no longer logs/acts as if memory is enough; it runs full status-bar verification. If remaining time is still above 20 minutes, it still skips refill.
- The status icon position is remembered as an offset inside the status rect, not a screen-absolute point.
  When the offset exists, the lightweight check first captures a small cached-position snapshot around that offset.
  If the cached snapshot misses, it falls back to the fixed window-relative status-bar crop:
  `STATUS_PANEL_X=901`, `STATUS_PANEL_Y=123`, `STATUS_PANEL_W=123`, `STATUS_PANEL_H=34`, scaled through `CoordinateHelper`.
- Reset/time audit:
  - Successful real item use still resets `lastIncenseUsedTime` to actual `System.currentTimeMillis()` and clears `nextIncenseRetryTime`.
  - Any status-bar proof that the buff icon is present clears stale failed-refill retry cooldown.
  - Full status OCR rebuilds `lastIncenseUsedTime` from remaining time, but remaining time is clamped to the internal 59-minute duration so a cyan `1 hour` read cannot push the memory timestamp into the future.

Verification:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed after the reset/time audit.
- Suggested runtime proof: after a fresh run, look for `memory-gate-icon-present` with threshold `50`, cached-point/full-status-rect probe logs, and after 50 minutes look for `状态栏完整校验`; if full status OCR reads remaining time above 20 minutes, it should skip bag opening.

Runtime follow-up from 2026-06-21 13:48-13:58 五倍 run:

- User reported `67555` and `忆叶知秋` still refilled 摄妖香 while the UI showed roughly 50+ minutes remaining.
- Confirmed `67555` is `hwnd-60312BA / 刑部ㄨ忍者（ID：67555）`; `忆叶知秋` is `hwnd-CF07B4 / ID：451753529`.
- Fresh log evidence for `67555`:
  - `13:54:05.315`: `memory-gate-icon-absent-refill: fresh memory age=7m < 50m` then opened bag and used 摄妖香 at `13:54:11.350`.
  - `13:56:00.799`: same false-absent path at age `1m`, then used 摄妖香 again at `13:56:06.161`.
  - Saved probe image: `images/temp/hwnd-60312BA/sheyaoxiang_status_icon_gate_status-rect.png`.
- `忆叶知秋 / hwnd-CF07B4` later has positive proof:
  - `13:55:29.775`: `memory-gate-icon-present: mode=cached-point ... age=1m`, no bag open.
  - `13:56:42.277`: `memory-gate-icon-present: mode=cached-point ... age=2m`, no bag open.
- Root-cause refinement: the status-bar probe must not capture while the mouse is hovering over the buff area.
  The fresh-memory false absent can happen if the cursor sits on/near the status icon and changes the rendered icon/tooltip state before template matching.
- Additional implementation:
  - `probeIncenseIconPresenceInRect(...)` and full `probeIncenseStatus(...)` now move the mouse to the same safe top-left player-state point before capturing.
  - Existing blood/mana bar capture was already doing this through the same input queue/direct-input split; the helper was renamed from bars-only wording to `moveMouseAwayBeforePlayerStateSnapshot`.
  - The misleading log after a fresh-memory icon miss was changed from "超过内存信任窗口" to "进入状态栏/补香校验流程".
- Verification after this additional patch:
  - `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed.

### Codex - 2026-06-21 / CR72 战后摄妖香状态栏复核卡

Status: sprint card only; no Java/business/OCR/template/click/navigation code changed.

Docs / required context read:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/DHXY_CONTEXT.md`
- `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `docs/ACTIVE_WORK.md`

User-approved problem / direction:

- Current 摄妖香 post-combat check can trust `lastIncenseUsedTime` too early.
- If memory says the incense was used recently and is still inside the 50-minute memory-trust window,
  `PlayerStateService.ensureSheYaoXiangActive(...)` returns before any status-bar icon proof or bag
  check.
- This makes memory time the only fact during the fresh-memory window. Pause/resume, abnormal
  combat enter/exit ordering, stale exit-signal consumption, or a bad status probe can make that
  unsafe.
- New rule: memory time is only a throttle for avoiding frequent bag opens. It cannot override the
  real status-bar fact that the 摄妖香 icon is absent.

Code path checked:

- `PlayerStateService.ensureSheYaoXiangActive(...)` currently checks
  `state.lastIncenseUsedTime > 0 && now - state.lastIncenseUsedTime < INCENSE_MEMORY_TRUST_MS`
  before calling `probeIncenseStatus(...)`.
- `AutoCombatService` calls
  `playerStateService.ensureSheYaoXiangActiveForLeaderTask(source + ":post-combat", context)` after
  post-combat recovery when leader 摄妖香 checking is enabled.
- Existing `probeIncenseStatus(...)` already captures the right-status-bar region and matches
  `images/template/status/sheyaoxiang_buff.png`, then reads cyan hour / green minute text.

Sprint Board update:

- Published CR72 in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- CR72 requirements:
  - before the 50-minute fresh-memory trust shortcut returns, do a lightweight status-bar 摄妖香 icon
    presence check;
  - icon present: keep trusting memory and do not open the bag;
  - icon absent: refill immediately and reset `lastIncenseUsedTime` to actual use time;
  - icon unknown: run the existing full status probe; if still unknown/not found, refill
    conservatively;
  - remember only the last matched offset inside the status rect, not a screen-absolute point; use it
    for a cached-position snapshot first, then fall back to the fixed window-relative status rect if
    the cached snapshot misses;
  - do not change item template, bag click algorithm, OCR thresholds, navigation, combat recovery,
    first-aid, maintenance, or 五倍/修罗 business flows.

Performance goal check:

- No new runtime performance evidence was collected in this docs-only pass.
- Expected impact is a small bounded post-combat status-icon crop when memory says 摄妖香 is fresh.
  It should be far cheaper than opening the bag and should not add runner `100ms` / task `900ms`
  churn.
- Runtime acceptance must still verify no bag spam when the icon is present and no p95/p99
  post-combat regression large enough to affect task flow.

### Codex - 2026-06-20 / CR67 task-tracker expanded fallback coordinate bug

Status: Investigation complete; sprint card published. No Java/business/OCR/template/click/navigation code changed.

- `AGENTS.md`

- `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`

Evidence checked:

- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/TaskTrackerPanelService.java`
  - `narrow-default` calls `coordinateHelper.findImageInRegion(...)` with a screen-absolute
    `searchRect`, so the returned anchor is screen-absolute.
  - `expanded` calls `tracker.updateGlobalVision()` and then `ImageFinder.find(latest_vision.png,
    ...)`, so the returned anchor is local to the bound-window screenshot.
  - Current code stores both into the same `anchor` and later computes `panelRect` / calls
    `captureToFile(...)` as if both were screen-absolute.
- Fresh `logs/dhxy-console.log` around `2026-06-20 23:44:53-23:45:42`:
  - 岁月 `hwnd-74E07A0` repeatedly missed `narrow-default`, entered `expanded`, matched
    `anchor=(102,201)`, then produced `rect=(6,213)-(188,551)`.
  - The same capture logs show `base=(398,255)` and `relative=(-392,-42)`, proving the expanded
    match was not converted from window-local to screen-absolute.
  - Other windows with `mode=narrow-default` had screen anchors such as `(1481,517)` / `(692,716)`,
    which explains why the bug was masked for most windows.

Sprint board update:

- Published CR67 in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Scope is `TaskTrackerPanelService` expanded fallback coordinate conversion only.
- This is not CR54 because it is not 黄袍 chained tracker fast-cache behavior.
- This is not CR57 because it is not runner dialog screenshot sharing.

Baseline / worktree context:

- Current branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`
- Current HEAD: `2a97dd4309f4b14742cfcb741798d82d64fc230c`
- `origin/dev`: `e543d024bf900853944b36d27d0f736005d9eeb9`
- 五倍 business baseline used elsewhere: `origin/codex/migrate-runner-dialog` /
  `3f0a2e79007121c98a15ad90d5ed7b8902033068`
- Summon-skill old behavior baseline checked here: `13fc663`
- Regression-introducing refactor checked here: `dc0ac9e`
- Working tree was already dirty before this triage, including `SummonSkillService.java` and
  `TaskMaintenanceService.java`; do not revert unrelated user/agent changes.

Runtime evidence:

- `logs/dhxy-console.log` around `2026-06-20 16:33:48-16:33:59` confirms the reported issue:
  - `16:33:48.046` hwnd-74E07A0 三技能维护 due/claimed, `source=auto-battle`.
  - `16:33:51.977` detected 6 skill slots and started at slot 4.
  - `16:33:53.915` slot 4 status was `LOCKED_SLOT`.
  - Same timestamp: tail pass finished with `inspected=1 deleted=0 nextStartSlot=4`.
  - Same timestamp: exclusive pass finished `completed=true success=true`.
  - `TaskMaintenanceService` success path then updates summon-skill window state and
    `lastSummonSkillCleanAt`, causing the long cooldown even though earlier slots were not checked.

Code evidence:

- Current `SummonSkillService.cleanTailNormalSkillsDirect(...)`:
  - `LOCKED_SLOT` branch only sets `nextStartIndex = index` and `break`.
  - Loop exit then returns `buildCleanupResult(true, ...)`.
- Current `TaskMaintenanceService.runSummonSkill...` success path:
  - If `cleanupResult.isSuccess()`, it calls `updateSummonSkillWindowState(...)` and refreshes
    `lastSummonSkillCleanAtByWindow`.
- Old `13fc663` `SummonSkillService`:
  - `LOCKED_OR_EMPTY` calls `findNearestOpenedSlotBackward(slots, index - 1, deadlineAtMs)`.
  - If nearest is `NORMAL_SKILL`, it deletes that nearest prior slot.
  - If nearest is `KEEP_SKILL` or null, it stops.
- `dc0ac9e` split old `LOCKED_OR_EMPTY` into `EMPTY_SLOT` / `LOCKED_SLOT` and added
  `SummonSkillCleanupResult`, but removed the backward-scan behavior from the locked-slot path.

Decision:

- Published CR63 in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Required fix direction: restore old locked/empty boundary scan semantics in the current result model.
- Do not change summon panel coordinates, templates, OCR thresholds, click locations, input ownership,
  maintenance broadcast priority, or WUBEI/修罗 task flow.
- Incomplete locked-slot scan must not be counted as success/cooldown unless it reaches the old safe
  stop condition.

CR62 implementation intent:

- Keep 修罗 task-side ownership of battle exit and recovery.
- Do not lower combat detection frequency or move post-combat recovery into Runner.
- When 修罗 `WAIT_COMBAT` observes `IN_COMBAT`, return an event-wait outcome that parks on the
  current window's `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED` instead of relying only on the 900ms handoff loop.
- Re-enter `WAIT_COMBAT` after wake and call `handleCombatTick(...)` again to consume
  `EXIT_RECOVERED` or confirm combat is still running.

CR62 implementation / verification:

- Added scheduling-only 修罗 wait model:
  - `XiuluoWaitReason`
  - `XiuluoWaitSpec`
  - `XiuluoStepOutcome.waitSpec`
- `XiuluoTaskV2.waitCombat(...)` now wraps the `IN_COMBAT` outcome with
  `waitForCombatStateWake(...)`.
- `waitForCombatStateWake(...)` captures `windowReadyEventBus.currentSequence()` before the outcome
  is returned, then waits for the current window's `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED` event. This avoids losing
  an event that appears between task-turn release and actual parking.
- `yieldAfterMustYield(...)` now detects a 修罗 wait spec and uses `parkAfterYieldIfNeeded(...)`

  - `WAIT_COMBAT -> RETURN_HOME` still happens in `XiuluoTaskV2`, not Runner.

    WindowReadyEventBus.java WindowReadyEventType.java` shows only `WubeiTask.java` changed in that
    pushed commit for this scope.
- Relevant local pre-CR59 evidence:
  - `WubeiTask.java` still had `WUBEI_PREPARED_DIALOG_POLL_MS = 80L`.
  - `waitForPreparedWubeiDialog(...)` did `TaskSleep.sleepOrStop(... min(80ms, remaining))` then
    `tryConsumePreparedWubeiDialog(... ":poll", false)` until the 15s accept timeout expired.
  - `waitForPreparedWubeiDialogReply(...)` looped forever with
    `tryConsumePreparedWubeiDialog(... ":runner-reply", shouldRefreshInterest)` then
    `TaskSleep.sleepOrStop(... 80ms ...)`, and re-enabled refresh after the first miss.
  - `WindowReadyEventBus` already has `currentSequence()` and `awaitNewer(... PREPARED_ACTION_READY
    ...)` from earlier CR41+ framework work, so CR59 can use that instead of adding new bus APIs.

CR59 implementation intent:

- Replace same-window prepared-dialog polling with event wake:
  - consume once on entry;
  - register/refresh interest once when requested;
  - capture `currentSequence()` immediately before waiting;
  - wake only on newer `PREPARED_ACTION_READY`;
  - after a matching event, consume once;
  - ignore mismatched operation/target events and continue until the existing business deadline.
- Preserve accept-task's existing 15s foreground business timeout.
- Preserve 白龙马/probe targetReady enter-battle's existing 300s timeout and 5s timeout recheck.
- Do not change 白龙马 probe result meanings, 普通怪/黄袍 first-battle terminal/timeout rules,
  黄袍续战 hot-path click rules, OCR/template thresholds, click coordinates, navigation, direct
  combat, tooltip, or Alt+A policy.

Implementation summary:

- `WubeiTask.waitForPreparedWubeiDialog(...)` no longer sleeps up to 80ms and retries consume inside
  the accept-task foreground timeout.
  - It captures the ready-event sequence before the entry consume.
  - It consumes once on entry, refreshing interest only for that one entry consume when requested.
  - It waits for newer current-window `PREPARED_ACTION_READY` events until the existing 15s accept
    business timeout expires.
  - It ignores mismatched prepared operations and consumes once after each matching ready event.
- `WubeiTask.waitForPreparedWubeiDialogReply(...)` no longer loops through
  `TaskSleep(80ms) -> consume`.
  - It performs one entry consume / optional interest refresh.

Independent findings:

- Current `WindowTaskRunner` has a single hot dialog prepare interval and can keep observer ticks hot
  when a prepared action exists.
- Existing prepared actions can be revalidated in watcher ticks through fingerprint comparison,
  refreshing `lastVerifiedAtMs` and republishing READY. This turns the `2500ms/3000ms` freshness
  fence into background "keepalive" and creates CPU/log pressure.
- The fix must be framework/performance plumbing only: do not change task business decisions,
  template thresholds, OCR fallback, click coordinates, route order, probe branching, or 黄袍/普通/
  白龙马/修罗 phase behavior.

Sprint board changes:

- Added CR58 row to `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Added detailed `Card CR58: Prepared action READY 后停止后台 100ms fingerprint 续命`.

CR58 fixed implementation contract:

- Before prepared:
  - `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE`: `100ms`;
  - `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY`: `200ms`;
  - `ROUTE_TRANSFER`: `1000ms`;
  - `TASK_TRACKER_PATHING`: `1000ms`;
  - every other `DialogOperation`: `500ms`.
- After prepared:
  - same action must not keep watcher at `100ms`;
  - same action must not be background fingerprint-revalidated just to refresh `lastVerifiedAtMs`;
  - same action must not repeatedly publish `PREPARED_ACTION_READY`.
- Consume:
  - every `clickRequired=true` action must perform validation-rect fingerprint verification
    immediately before atomic consume/click;
  - validation failure clears the same action and does not click old coordinates;
  - every `clickRequired=false` business signal skips fingerprint validation and must not be rejected
    solely because `lastVerifiedAtMs` is older than the click-action freshness window.

Performance goal check:

- No new runtime evidence in this documentation-only turn.
- CR58 is designed to reduce repeated `prepared-action-verified`, duplicate READY publishes, and
  observer `100ms` pressure after an action is already prepared, while preserving `prepared -> consume`
  and enter-battle/route latency through consume-time validation.

Testing recommendation:

- Do not restart just for this documentation-only card.
- After CR58 is implemented, restart and run fresh 五倍/黄袍/白龙马/修罗 slices to prove reduced
  prepared-ready log pressure and no p95/p99 prepared-action latency regression.

  full `DialogDetection` once per watcher tick instead of only reading `DialogType`.

  prepare paths now accept an optional supplied `DialogDetection`.

    matches.

    explicitly allowed by the current interest.

  Existing providers can ignore it; `WubeiDialogPreparationProvider` uses it for accept task,
  enter-battle, and probe story preparation.
- `WindowTaskRunner` now creates one local `TickDialogProbe` per watcher tick and passes it through:
  - task attention;
  - route/remembered route preparation;
  - task dialog-interest preparation;
  - final task attention.
  The probe is local to one loop iteration and never stores `BufferedImage` in
  `WindowDialogSnapshot` or `WindowRuntimeContext`.
- No minimap/pathing, battle radar, tracker panel parsing, NPC click, world-map route matching,
  OCR/template thresholds, click coordinates, navigation semantics, prepared-action consume
  semantics, or task fallback order were changed for CR57.

### 唐德 - 2026-06-19 / 五环第二轮鞋需求误判修复

Status: Java code changed / compile passed.

Request:

- User observed window `67555` with 五环 configured for 2 runs: first run bought 2 shoes, second run
  should only need the remaining 1 shoe, but the task re-entered the buy-shoe flow.

Root cause:

- `FiveRingTaskV2.prepare(...)` was using the configured total run count as the required shoe count
  on every round.
- With `wuhuanMaxRuns=2`, round 2 still logged `requiredShoes=2`; a remaining single shoe was
  therefore treated as insufficient.

Change:

- `FiveRingTaskV2` now calculates shoe requirement from remaining runs:
  - round 1 of 2 requires 2 shoes;
  - round 2 of 2 requires 1 shoe;
  - unlimited/legacy non-positive run count requires only the current-run shoe.
- `BUY_SHOES` fallback now uses the same remaining-run calculation when no explicit missing count is
  carried in `FiveRingPhaseContext`.

Verification:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed.

### Codex - 2026-06-19 / CR47 third-view review after interest-lifetime clarification

Status: Blocked / business-lifetime mismatch found / no business code changed by reviewer.

Scope:

- User asked to review CR47 again.
- Rechecked against `docs/业务逻辑.md` 黄袍怪 points 20-24 and the clarified rule from the user:
  `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` interest should be cleared by entering battle / phase reset / task reset, not by
  a short automatic expiry while the leader is still waiting for Runner.

Finding:

- CR47 correctly moved 黄袍 continuation `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` interest before the physical
  `chained-combat-*` green click, and it still avoids ordinary pathing intent for continuation.
- But the implementation still calls the generic `registerWubeiDialogInterest(...)`, which sets
  `expiresAtMs = now + WUBEI_DIALOG_INTEREST_TTL_MS` (`15_000ms`).
- During the continuation `ENTER_BATTLE` bounded retry, `tickEnterBattle(...)` only registers the
  phase-start interest when `enterBattleStartedAt <= 0`, and `continueChainedEnterBattleInPhase(...)`
  only sleeps/retries the same phase; it does not keep the continuation interest alive.
- Therefore a 黄袍 continuation can still lose `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` authorization after about 15s
  while it is still in the valid continuation入战 phase. Runner would then see `OPTION` as visible
  attention/no operation instead of preparing the allowed `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` action. This is the
  same class of business mismatch as the 15:59 黄袍 first-battle interest expiry, just in CR47's
  post-first-battle hot path.

Evidence:

- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:2245` registers pre-click continuation
  interest through `registerWubeiDialogInterest(...)`.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:1854` sets the generic interest expiry to
  `System.currentTimeMillis() + WUBEI_DIALOG_INTEREST_TTL_MS`.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:187` defines that TTL as `15_000L`.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:2910-2920` registers phase-start interest
  only once per enter-battle runtime.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:3036-3044` continuation retry only sleeps
  and retries the same phase; it does not refresh or phase-own the interest.

Required fix for CR47:

- Give 黄袍 continuation `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` interest a phase-owned lifetime: valid from before the
  `chained-combat-*` click until prepared action is consumed and `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` starts, or
  until continuation fails/resets/stops.
- Do not let the 15s generic TTL decide continuation business behavior.
- Clear the continuation interest explicitly on successful prepared consumption / entering
  `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH`, click failure, task reset, or failure path.
- Fresh validation should show no `window.dialog.interest.clear ... reason=expired` for
  `wubei:chained-enter-battle-before-click:*` while the continuation `ENTER_BATTLE` phase is still
  active.

- After the ordinary tracker green-link click, the leader releases the turn and waits for Runner.
- Runner observes only; it does not click, close dialogs, OCR tooltip targets, or mutate task state.
- Runner first checks visible dialog type. Only `DialogType.OPTION` can be considered for ordinary
  `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE`.
- `OPTION` with successful ordinary enter-battle template match prepares `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` and
  publishes `PREPARED_ACTION_READY`.
- `OPTION` template miss must not publish a business result and must not wake the leader.
- `STORY`, `NONE`, and all other non-`OPTION` dialog facts must be ignored for ordinary monsters.
- During ordinary wait, the only valid leader wake results are `PREPARED_ACTION_READY /
  WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` and `PATHING_TERMINAL`.

Planned scope:

- Claim CR42 and narrow the Runner/provider path so ordinary `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` preparation only
  produces a result on `OPTION + green-template hit`.
- Do not alter 白龙马 CR39/CR40 `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY`, route transfer, accept task, 黄袍怪, 修罗, 五环,
  OCR/template thresholds, click coordinates, or movement logic.

Implemented:

- `WindowTaskRunner.publishTaskAttentionIfDialogVisible(...)` now detects the ordinary-monster
  delayed enter-battle interest by source prefix `wubei:normal-enter-battle`.
- For that ordinary path only:
  - `STORY`, `NONE`, and other non-`OPTION` visible dialogs are logged as ignored and do not publish
    a wake event.
  - `OPTION` dialogs call the existing task dialog preparation provider.
  - If the `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` green template misses, no business result / wake event is published.
  - If the template hits, the existing prepared-action path publishes `PREPARED_ACTION_READY`.
- `WubeiDialogPreparationProvider` now calls `prepareGreenTemplateOption(..., verifyDialogType=true)`
  for `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE`, so STORY/non-OPTION cannot be treated as an enter-battle template scan.

### Codex - 2026-06-19 Latest-push Wubei business baseline CR

Status: DONE / documentation-only CR / no Java behavior changes.

Reviewer: 何黎, third-view assistant for 谢帅.

Baseline:

- Latest pushed business baseline:
  `3f0a2e7 (HEAD -> codex/migrate-runner-dialog, origin/codex/migrate-runner-dialog)`
  `Add short first-aid gate for Wubei chained combat`.
- Scope requested by user: only 五倍 business logic deltas between the latest pushed code and the
  current local working tree. The pushed behavior must remain the source of truth unless 谢帅 opens
  an explicit Story/Sprint Task and the user approves the behavior change.

Commands / files reviewed:

- `git log --oneline -1 --decorate`
- `git status --short`
- `git diff --name-status -- src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/NavigationService.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/TaskMaintenanceService.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/AutoBattleTask.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/execution/WindowTaskRunner.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/model/WindowReadyEventType.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/runtime/WindowReadyEventBus.java src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/runtime/WindowRuntimeContext.java`
- `git diff --unified=12 -- ...` plus focused `rg` checks for Wubei wait, probe, route,
  enter-battle, maintenance, navigation-intent, and runner ready-event logic.

P1 business-logic CR findings for 谢帅:

1. 接任务 NPC route wait release conditions are broadened. Latest pushed code only released the
   accept-NPC pathing wait for a fresh matching prepared route dialog. Local code adds
   `recoverStaleAcceptNpcCurrentMapPathing(...)`, accepts READY / REQUESTED / PREPARING route facts,
   visible actionable dialogs, terminal pathing events, and a 15s current-map recheck that can clear
   pathing and retry navigation. This changes when 五倍 decides "route is done enough" and when it
   retries current-map navigation. Needs a separate route-recovery Story.

2. Enter-battle priority changed. Latest pushed `tickEnterBattle(...)` performed the existing
   auto-combat / known-dialog / tracker fallback flow inside the phase. Local code registers
   `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` interest, immediately parks for a runner prepared action, and also checks
   fresh prepared enter-battle actions before and after combat handling. This changes the pushed
   priority order for entering battle and should not be bundled with runner migration without Story
   approval.

3. Probe enter-battle timeout path changed inside inner waits. Local
   `throwProbeEnterBattleTimeoutIfNeeded(...)` throws `ProbeEnterBattleTimeoutSignal` from dialog
   wait loops and routes back through the phase outcome. Latest pushed behavior did not inject that
   exception path into the inner wait in the same way. This changes recovery timing after failed
   enter-battle preparation and needs its own CR/testcase task.

4. 五倍 maintenance behavior is now gated by team maintenance windows. Local
   `maybeRunLeaderPathingSummonMaintenance(...)` requires
   `isTeamPathingMaintenanceWindowOpen(...)` and sets `requireOpenTeamMaintenanceWindow(true)`.
   `AutoBattleTask` also gates follower maintenance broadcast handling for Wubei/Xiuluo support
   modes. Latest pushed code did not apply the same gate to these paths. This changes when helpers
   heal/summon/respond during 五倍 and should be split as a maintenance-window Story.

5. Navigation route-intent matching changed for 五倍 route dialogs. Local `NavigationService`
   accepts a prepared `ROUTE_TRANSFER` when the active intent id differs but the target map matches,
   and reuses fresh non-coordinate route intents at the world-map gate. Latest pushed matching was
   stricter around active intent identity. This can make 五倍 consume route dialogs under different
   intent evidence and needs a navigation-intent Story/test replay.

Explicitly not counted as business-logic findings in this review:

- Replacing active polling with runner/park wait for prepared dialog is part of the current
  architecture migration and is not a CR finding by itself.
- Parking battle wait on a runner/watcher combat-state event is also architecture migration work and
  is not a business-logic finding by itself.
- `WubeiStepOutcome` / `WubeiWaitSpec`, `WindowReadyEventBus`, and runner latency diagnostics are
  treated as scheduling infrastructure unless they change a concrete 五倍 decision listed above.

Recommendation to 谢帅:

- Open one Sprint Task titled "Restore Wubei latest-push business baseline before runner/park
  migration" and attach only the business-logic P1 list above as acceptance criteria.
- Then split any desired retained behavior into separate Stories: accept-NPC route recovery,
  enter-battle prepared-action priority, probe enter-battle timeout recovery, maintenance-window
  gate, and navigation route-intent reuse.
- Until those Stories are approved, the local implementation should be treated as non-baseline for
  五倍 business behavior only for the concrete decision changes listed above. Runner/park migration
  itself remains in-scope architecture work.

  `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY target=wubei.probeNoTarget matchedText=WHITE_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` wrapper is a
  template-miss/unknown signal, but the current local `WubeiTask` interprets it as confirmed
  no-target.
- This audit verified that claim against the local working tree, origin commit, and logs.
- This round did not modify Java, OCR/template, click, navigation, or task behavior.

```powershell

```

Evidence:

- Branch is `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`; local HEAD and `origin/codex/migrate-runner-dialog` are
  both `3f0a2e79007121c98a15ad90d5ed7b8902033068`.
- The working tree has uncommitted `WubeiTask.java` changes.
- Local `WubeiTask.java` now converts non-click `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY / target=wubei.probeNoTarget`
  into a `DialogResultStatus.WHITE_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` result, then checks
  `isProbeNoTargetStoryVisible(...)`.
- The local `isProbeNoTargetStoryVisible(...)` branch returns true for
  `actionKey=wubei.probeNoTarget`, `status=WHITE_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`, `dialogType=STORY`, and sits
  before `closeUnknownProbeStoryIfNeeded(...)` and `tryClickProbeSpawnedTarget(..., false)`.
- Log `2026-06-18 18:35:55.192` confirms this path: consumed
  `operation=WUBEI_PROBE_STORY target=wubei.probeNoTarget`, logged
  `probe no-target story check: label=second-probe visible=true`, then failed with
  `probe no target and no unused point remains`.
- User-provided first-probe slice `18:35:25.791-18:35:26.221` matches the same logic: first-probe
  was marked resolved and switched to second-probe before the old 白龙马 tooltip fallback.

Conclusion:

- User's root cause is valid.
- Runner packaging is not the immediate bug. The local task-side interpretation is the bug:
  `WHITE_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND / wubei.probeNoTarget` must be treated as a template-miss/unknown signal,
  not as confirmed no-target.
- Required CR29 fix: restore the old order for this signal:
  `closeUnknownProbeStoryIfNeeded(...)` -> `tryClickProbeSpawnedTarget(..., false)` -> only after the
  tooltip fallback cannot enter battle should the current probe be marked resolved and the next
  probe tried.

### Codex - 2026-06-18 CR30 published / ENTER_BATTLE prepared dialog must outrank stale combat-exit recovery

Status: DONE / docs-code-log audit only / no Java changes / new sprint card CR30.

Context:

- User provided a concrete root-cause audit for the `18:05:51` enter-battle skip:
  Runner prepared `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE`, but `tickEnterBattle(...)` ran
  `autoCombatService.handleCombatTick(...)` first and accepted `EXIT_RECOVERED`, so the task jumped
  to `POST_BATTLE_RECOVER` / `RETURN_HOME` while the entry dialog was still on screen.
- This round verified the feedback against source and logs before publishing a card.
- No Java, OCR/template, click, navigation, or business behavior was changed in this entry.

Commands:

```powershell
Get-Content -Raw AGENTS.md
Get-Content -Raw docs\DHXY_CONTEXT.md
Get-Content -Raw docs\PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md
Get-Content -Raw docs\ACTIVE_WORK.md
Get-Content -Path src\main\java\com\bot\dhxy\task\wubei\WubeiTask.java | Select-Object -Skip 3180 -First 80
rg -n "WUBEI_PREPARED_DIALOG_MAX_AGE_MS|tickEnterBattle|EXIT_RECOVERED|prepared-stale|battle dialog clicked|combat ended during enter battle phase" src\main\java\com\bot\dhxy\task\wubei\WubeiTask.java logs\dhxy-console.log docs\PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md docs\ACTIVE_WORK.md
```

Verified source finding:

- `WUBEI_PREPARED_DIALOG_MAX_AGE_MS = 3_000L`.
- In `WubeiTask.tickEnterBattle(...)`, the current order is:
  - register `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` interest on first phase entry;
  - run `autoCombatService.handleCombatTick(...)`;
  - if tick is `IN_COMBAT`, go to `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH`;
  - if tick is `EXIT_RECOVERED`, immediately go to `POST_BATTLE_RECOVER`;
  - only after that, call `tryClickKnownEnterBattleDialog(...)`.
- Therefore a fresh prepared enter-battle action can be bypassed by a stale or previous-combat
  `EXIT_RECOVERED` result before the prepared click is consumed.

Verified log finding:

- `18:05:50.619`: `RESOLVE_AFTER_PATHING -> ENTER_BATTLE`.
- `18:05:51.415`: Runner prepared `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE target=wubei.enterBattle click=(1682,480)`.
- `18:05:51-18:05:55`: no `clickLeft` for `(1682,480)` and no `battle dialog clicked`.
- `18:05:55.293`: `phase=ENTER_BATTLE ... next=POST_BATTLE_RECOVER message=combat ended during enter battle phase`.
- `18:05:55.295` and `18:05:56.177`: ready `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` is already stale:
  `prepared-stale:3878ms` and then `prepared-stale:4762ms`.
- `18:05:56.177+`: WUBEI enters `RETURN_HOME`, and the route proceeds as `normal-combat` recovery.

Sprint board update:

- Published `CR30` as `Ready / Unclaimed`.
- CR30 is intentionally narrower than CR26:
  - CR26 remains the broader White Dragon target-click phase-gate discussion.
  - CR30 only fixes `tickEnterBattle(...)` priority when a fresh Runner-prepared
    `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` action exists but `AutoCombatService` returns `EXIT_RECOVERED`.

Acceptance expectation:

- When a fresh `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` prepared action exists, `tickEnterBattle(...)` must consume/click
  it before accepting `EXIT_RECOVERED` as post-combat recovery.
- Keep `IN_COMBAT` as a valid independent battle-confirmed path.
- Do not change templates, thresholds, click coordinates, route/navigation, 白龙马 prompt order, or
  AutoA/AltA fallback in this card.

Restart / test recommendation:

- Do not restart expecting this specific fix yet; CR30 is only published, not implemented.
- After CR30 is implemented and compile passes, restart for focused validation around the
  enter-battle path. The key negative evidence should disappear:
  no `combat ended during enter battle phase` while a fresh `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` prepared action is
  pending, and no `ready dialog pending too long ... WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` in
  `POST_BATTLE_RECOVER` / `RETURN_HOME`.

Status: REVIEW / source patch + compile passed / needs post-restart WUBEI task-run validation.

  instead of falling through unknown-story cleanup and no-story smart target click.

Finding:

- Logs showed the exact bad path: prepared `target=wubei.probeNoTarget` was consumed, then
  `unknown probe story cleanup` ran, followed by `try smart combat target click:
  label=first-probe-no-story`.
- Root cause was in `resolveProbeAfterPathing(...)`: it only handled target-ready and
  wrong-position probe stories. `probeNoTarget` was represented as
  `WHITE_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND + actionKey=wubei.probeNoTarget`, then fell through to the unknown
  story cleanup and tentative smart target click fallback.

Change:

- `WubeiTask.resolveProbeAfterPathing(...)` now handles explicit `probeNoTarget` before unknown
  story cleanup:
  mark the current probe resolved, advance to the next unused probe, or fail clearly if no unused
  probe remains.
- Added `isProbeNoTargetStoryVisible(...)` as the narrow semantic gate. Target-ready,
  wrong-position, and no-prepared-result behavior were not changed.

### 谢帅 - 2026-06-18 Sprint CR27 probe visible STORY handoff

Status: REVIEW / compile passed / needs post-restart log validation.

Context:

- Heartbeat `dhxy-sprint-board-heartbeat` found `CR27 | Unclaimed | Ready` and claimed it for `谢帅`.
- Investigated `2026-06-18 16:23:50-16:24:02` and matching earlier/later slices.
- Bad path: tracker green click starts probe pathing, Runner sees visible `STORY` and publishes
  `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED source=dialog-visible:STORY operation=null`, but `WubeiTask.resolveProbeAfterPathing(...)`
  returns `probe runner pathing still active` before it can register/consume `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY`.
- Working contrast from the same log: once WUBEI has registered `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY` interest, Runner uses
  `active-pathing-dialog-first`, prepares `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY`, and the task consumes the prepared result.

Changed:

- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java`
  - In `resolveProbeAfterPathing(...)`, active probe pathing with a fresh visible `STORY` now starts
    `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY` interest and returns a prepared-dialog wait instead of another generic
    `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL`.
  - If the probe story wait is already active, active pathing keeps waiting for Runner's prepared
    probe-story result rather than falling back to pathing-terminal polling.
  - Added small helpers `hasFreshVisibleProbeStory(...)` and `beginProbeStoryWaitFromVisibleDialog(...)`.
  - Did not change CR18's generic wait gate: unrelated operation-null `STORY` still does not satisfy
    generic pathing waits globally; this takeover is scoped to 五倍 probe pathing only.
- `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`
  - `CR27` moved to `Review: needs post-restart validation`.

Verification:

```powershell
mvn -q -DskipTests compile
git diff --check -- src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md docs/ACTIVE_WORK.md
```

- Result: compile passed.
- `git diff --check` had only LF/CRLF working-copy warnings.
- There is no existing Java test infrastructure in this repo (`src/test` and test dependencies are absent), so this card used source-level verification plus compile. Runtime acceptance still requires a restarted run.

Remaining:

- Restart the app/script before judging CR27 runtime behavior.
- Post-restart log should show visible STORY during 五倍 probe pathing leading to
  `window.dialog.interest.update ... operations=[WUBEI_PROBE_STORY]`,
  `task dialog prepared ... operation=WUBEI_PROBE_STORY`, or a bounded prepared-dialog wait, rather
  than repeated `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` timeouts with `source=probe runner pathing still active`.
- Confirm unrelated operation-null `STORY` in non-probe pathing still does not satisfy generic
  `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` / `WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE`.

Findings:

- CR25 is still timeout-heavy but does not hard-block this slice: the leader loops in
  `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` through many `wakeResult=timeout` events, then `BattleRadarService` emits
  `combat finished` at `16:23:29.729`, and WUBEI proceeds through `POST_BATTLE_RECOVER`,
  `RETURN_HOME`, `WAIT_TEAM_RETURN`, and accepts the next task.
- WUBEI accept still consumes Runner-prepared action correctly: at `16:23:44.876-16:23:45.256`,
  Runner publishes `WUBEI_ACCEPT_TASK`, task consumes it with `preparedAgeMs=26`, and
  `[wubei] accept option result: status=GREEN_TEMPLATE_CLICKED action=wubei.acceptTask clicked=true`.
- New root-cause candidate found after tracker green click:
  - `16:23:50.236` `TRACKER_PATHING` starts probe pathing and yields.
  - `16:23:55.291` `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` times out while runtime still shows `pathingState=ACTIVE`.
  - `16:23:57.626-16:23:57.644` Runner publishes `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` with
    `source=dialog-visible:STORY operation=null`; CR18 correctly makes `satisfied=false`, so WUBEI
    keeps `RESOLVE_AFTER_PATHING` with message `probe runner pathing still active`.
  - `16:24:02.836-16:24:02.844` it times out again with `pathingState=ACTIVE` and no prepared
    operation.
- This is not a CR18 regression: operation-null STORY should not satisfy generic pathing waits. The new
  issue is that 五倍 probe pathing has no follow-up handoff from visible STORY to a probe/story handler
  or a bounded recovery, so it can sit in `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL`/`RESOLVE_AFTER_PATHING` even after the
  relevant dialog appears.

### 唐德 - 2026-06-18 Sprint CR26 白龙马 enter-battle gate 调查

Status: BLOCKED / investigation complete / waiting for user approval on behavior patch.

Context:

- Heartbeat `dhxy-sprint-board-task-check` found `CR26 | Unclaimed | Ready: 白龙马 enter-battle gate`.
- Per sprint rules, I claimed CR26 by changing the board owner to `唐德` and status to `In Progress`.
- This is a behavior card, so the first pass is code/log investigation only. Do not change
  OCR/template/click/movement logic without an approved plan.

Investigation targets:

- Trace tooltip / smart target click paths that can move 五倍 into `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH`.
- Verify whether those paths wait for `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` prepared dialog consumption or independent
  combat confirmation.
- Record a concrete plan before any behavior patch.

Findings:

- `tryClickTrackerCombatTargetSmart(...)` does not return true immediately after
  `npcClickService.clickNpcSmart(...)`; it then calls `tryClickKnownEnterBattleDialog(...)`.
- `tryClickKnownEnterBattleDialog(...)` consumes `DialogOperation.WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` via
  `waitForPreparedWubeiDialogReply(...)` and only returns true for known enter-battle action keys.
- Latest logs confirm this path at `15:59:26`: repeated absent prepared replies were followed by
  Runner preparing `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE`, `window.ready.consumePrepared result=consumed`, a queued
  prepared-dialog click, and then `known enter-battle dialog check ... clicked=true`.
- `tryDirectCombatFromTrackerHint(...)` calls `npcClickService.tryDirectCombatTargetClick(...)`,
  whose JavaDoc and implementation require combat-radar verification before returning true. Latest
  log search did not show `direct-combat-target-clicked`, so this was not the observed live path.
- Remaining risk is ownership/phase semantics: `resolveProbeAfterPathing(...)` still moves directly
  to `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` with source `probe-tooltip-clicked` or `probe-tooltip-clicked-without-story`
  after the target-click helper returns true. That helper is currently gated, but the phase name/source
  makes future regressions easy and keeps the probe branch different from the normal `ENTER_BATTLE`
  phase.

Proposed behavior patch, pending approval:

- Change the 白龙马 probe target-click success branches in `resolveProbeAfterPathing(...)` to route
  through `ENTER_BATTLE` / prepared-dialog phase semantics instead of directly constructing
  `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH`.
- Keep `tryClickTrackerCombatTargetSmart(...)` and `tryDirectCombatFromTrackerHint(...)` targeting
  algorithms unchanged; do not touch OCR/template/click/movement logic.
- Preserve direct-combat fallback only as an independently combat-confirmed path.
- Validate with `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` and a post-restart log check that no probe branch reaches
  `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` without either `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` prepared consumption or confirmed combat.

### 唐德 - 2026-06-18 Sprint CR18 operation-null ready-state 收窄

Status: REVIEW / compile passed / needs post-restart validation.

Context:

- Heartbeat `dhxy-sprint-board-task-check` found `CR18 | 唐德 | Ready: post-restart blocker confirmed`.
- Per sprint rules, I claimed CR18 by changing the sprint board status to `In Progress`.
- Scope is scheduling/ready-state only: do not change OCR/template/click/movement logic.
- Initial root-cause evidence from the board and source: `WubeiTask.isWaitAlreadySatisfied(...)`
  currently lets `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` / `WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE` skip parking when only a visible
  `STORY/OPTION` or a type-only `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` event exists, even with
  `pathingState=ACTIVE` and `preparedOperation=null`.

Planned verification:

```powershell
mvn -q -DskipTests compile
git diff --check -- docs\PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md docs\ACTIVE_WORK.md src\main\java\com\bot\dhxy\task\wubei\WubeiTask.java
```

Changes:

- `WubeiTask.isWaitAlreadySatisfied(...)` now keeps `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` as a wake hint, but
  no longer treats visible `STORY/OPTION` or type-only operation-null attention as a reusable
  satisfied state for `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` / `WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE`.
- Pathing waits are satisfied only by terminal pathing, a fresh prepared action, or a ready event
  that is terminal pathing / operation-bearing task attention.
- Added a debug diagnostic when a visible dialog / ready event is rejected for pathing waits, so a
  post-restart run can prove whether the old churn is gone without changing OCR/template/click/move
  behavior.

Verification:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed.
- `git diff --check -- docs\PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md docs\ACTIVE_WORK.md src\main\java\com\bot\dhxy\task\wubei\WubeiTask.java`
  passed with CRLF normalization warnings only.

Remaining risk:

- Needs a restarted runtime log slice to confirm `RESOLVE_AFTER_PATHING same`,
  `consumePrepared.absent`, and repeated `tracker runner pathing still active` churn drop in the
  real 五倍 scenario.

### 唐德 - 2026-06-18 Sprint CR21 WUBEI startup role OCR timeout investigation

Status: BLOCKED / waiting for user approval on inconclusive-role startup policy / no Java behavior changes.

Context:

- Heartbeat `dhxy-sprint-board-task-check` found CR21 and CR22 Ready and unclaimed.
- Claimed CR21 first because it blocks post-restart validation before WUBEI phases can run.
- Scope is to inspect the startup role detection chain where a transient tooltip OCR timeout makes
  the requested WUBEI leader window resolve as `UNKNOWN` and get skipped.
- Per sprint rules, this pass will not change WUBEI business logic, OCR/template thresholds,
  dialog preparation, pathing classification, or click algorithms without approval.

Files inspected:

- `logs/dhxy-console.log`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/team/TeamRoleDetectionService.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/startup/TaskTeamAssignmentPolicy.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/execution/WindowTaskRunner.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/discovery/NativeWindowRegistrationMapper.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/core/TextRecognizer.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/config/TeamTaskProperties.java`

Evidence:

- `14:02:47.343` UI selected `WUBEI`; `14:02:47.487` scanner found `hwnd-600B2` title with
  player id `443075411`.
- The four non-leader windows OCR'd tooltip leader id `443075411` and were reassigned to
  `AUTO_BATTLE` as `MEMBER`, so member protection worked.
- `hwnd-600B2` attempt 2 saved a detected tooltip image:
  `images\temp\hwnd-600B2\team_role_tooltip_raw_pass1_attempt2.png`.
- `14:03:03.311` local OCR timed out on that image. The local-only OCR API returns an empty result for
  timeout/unavailable/no text, so the role detector lost the distinction between transient OCR failure
  and confirmed no text.
- Normal startup skips Alt+T fallback after tooltip OCR miss; `TeamRoleDetectionService` therefore
  returned plain `UNKNOWN`.
- `WindowTaskRunner` already tries fallback to `windowContext.getRole()` when live role is unknown,
  but fresh WUBEI registration sets role `UNKNOWN`, so there was no usable fallback.
- `TaskTeamAssignmentPolicy` treats `UNKNOWN` as not allowed for leader-only `WUBEI`, returning
  `TaskType.UNKNOWN`; `WindowTaskRunner` then skipped the task before WUBEI phases started.

- Add a richer role-detection result for startup while keeping the existing enum method for current
  callers.

  use a bounded retry/delay or a retryable startup-blocked decision with explicit logs, rather than
  silently converting the task to `UNKNOWN`.
- Keep normal startup Alt+T panel fallback disabled unless explicitly approved.
- Do not change OCR/template thresholds, WUBEI business logic, dialog preparation, pathing
  classification, or click algorithms.

Validation:

- Documentation-only investigation so far.
- `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md` CR21 moved to
  `Blocked: waiting for user approval on inconclusive-role startup policy`.

  click logic, OCR/template matching, navigation algorithms, or task behavior without approval.

Files inspected:

- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/TeamReturnService.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/AutoBattleTask.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/transaction/TaskTurnCoordinator.java`
- `logs/dhxy-console.log`
- `logs/archive/dhxy-console.2026-06-18.1.log`

Findings:

- `WubeiTask.runWaitTeamReturnPhase(...)` is a stateless template poll:
  `shouldYieldForTeamReturnSignal()` calls `TeamReturnService.isReturnTeamSignalPresent()`;
  if the leader-side template is still visible, 五倍 returns `SHARED_STATE_TRIGGERED` and stays in
  `WAIT_TEAM_RETURN`.
- `TaskTurnCoordinator` does release the task turn for `SHARED_STATE_TRIGGERED`, so members can
  theoretically run. The repeated cost comes from `WubeiTask.handoffDelayMs(...)`, which sleeps
  `bot.dhxy.return-team-leader-wait-poll-ms` (default 3000ms) for any source starting with
  `team-return-wait`.
- `TeamReturnService.isReturnTeamSignalPresent()` has no consumed/expired state. It only answers
  whether the leader-side `zhao.png` template is currently matched in the configured team area.
- The only member-side click path found is `AutoBattleTask.maybeRunIdleMaintenance(...)` ->
  `TeamReturnService.clickReturnTeamIfPresent(...)`. A successful click logs and submits
  `teamReturn:auto-battle`, but it does not publish/record an event for the leader to know useful
  member work happened.
- Current fresh `logs/dhxy-console.log` only has normal `WAIT_TEAM_RETURN` checks at `13:10` and
  `13:11` with `team return wait not needed`; the CR16 stale-loop evidence is documented in
  `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`, but the source path still permits that stale loop.

Proposed plan awaiting approval:

- Preserve one short leader yield when the leader first sees the return-team signal, so real members
  still get a chance to click `归队`.
- Record a lightweight member-return activity event when `clickReturnTeamIfPresent(...)` succeeds
  (window id, timestamp, source).
- Let `WAIT_TEAM_RETURN` continue waiting only if the leader signal is present and either a recent
  member-return activity exists or the first grace window has not expired.
- If the leader signal remains present but no member activity appears after the grace window, mark the
  leader signal as stale/expired for this wait and continue with a clear log instead of repeating
  3s sleeps.
- Keep return item click coordinates, return button template matching, OCR/template, and navigation
  behavior unchanged.

### 唐德 - 2026-06-18 Sprint CR19 accept-NPC route wait gate investigation

Status: DONE / investigation complete / waiting for approval before behavior code changes.

Context:

- Heartbeat `dhxy-sprint-board-task-check` found CR19 Ready and Unclaimed.
- Claimed CR19 before work by setting Owner to 唐德 and Status to In Progress in
  `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Scope is investigation-first: confirm whether `WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE` can still be satisfied by
  operation-null attention, unrelated visible dialog, or `REQUESTED`-only route preparation.
- Do not change OCR/template/click/movement or route-click behavior in this card without explicit
  approval.

Reviewed:

- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java`
- `logs/dhxy-console.log`
- `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`

Commands:

```powershell
Select-String -Path src\main\java\com\bot\dhxy\task\wubei\WubeiTask.java `
  -Pattern "WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE|waitForAcceptNpcPathingIfStillActive|acceptNpcRouteWakeFact|isFreshAcceptNpcRouteEvent|isWaitAlreadySatisfied|DialogPreparationPhase.REQUESTED|DialogPreparationPhase.PREPARING" `
  -Context 3,10

rg -n "accept NPC pathing gate released|WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE|route-dialog-REQUESTED|route-dialog-PREPARING|route-dialog-ready|prepared-route-dialog|task-attention-event|pathing-terminal-event|visible-dialog:type" logs\dhxy-console.log
```

Findings:

- `WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE` is still grouped with `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` inside
  `isWaitAlreadySatisfied(...)`.
  - It inherits `isActionableDialog(dialog)`, so any visible `OPTION` or `STORY` can make
    `parkAfterYieldIfNeeded(...)` skip the route wait.
  - It also inherits type-only `isMatchingReadyEvent(...)`, so operation-null
    `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` can satisfy the wait if the event type matches.
- `acceptNpcRouteWakeFact(...)` still releases the duplicate-navigation gate on
  `DialogPreparationPhase.REQUESTED` and `PREPARING` when the status matches `ROUTE_TRANSFER` /
  `宝象国`.
  - `REQUESTED` only proves the task asked Runner to prepare a route dialog; it does not prove a
    visible/ready/consumable route option exists.
- `acceptNpcRouteWakeFact(...)` also treats any actionable visible dialog as a release reason via
  `visible-dialog:type=...`, without checking that it is the expected route option.
- `isFreshAcceptNpcRouteEvent(...)` is shared for `PATHING_TERMINAL` and
  `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED`.
  - It first accepts `ROUTE_TRANSFER` / `宝象国`, which is fine.
  - It also accepts inherited `event.getPathingIntent().targetMapName` or
    `event.getPathingSnapshot().intent.targetMapName` for any fresh event. That is too broad for
    `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED`, because a route-targeted but operation-null attention can pass.
- Current log tail has little clean route-wait runtime evidence after pause, but it does show an
  old `dialog-visible:STORY` attention becoming stale and a later
  `consumePrepared result=absent ... expectedOperation=ROUTE_TRANSFER expectedTarget=宝象国`.
  The stronger evidence for CR19 is the code path itself.

Root cause:

- Accept-NPC route waits are meant to avoid duplicate world-map navigation while the watcher owns the
  route, but the current gate mixes three different facts:
  1. concrete route facts (`prepared ROUTE_TRANSFER`, `READY`, terminal pathing);
  2. weak intent/preparation facts (`REQUESTED`, `PREPARING`);
  3. generic attention facts (`visible OPTION/STORY`, operation-null attention).
- Because all three can release/skip the wait, CR19 can reproduce CR18-style same-window churn or
  premature duplicate-navigation gate release without a consumable route action.

Proposed change, pending approval:

- Split `WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE` from `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` in `isWaitAlreadySatisfied(...)`.
- For `WAIT_ACCEPT_NPC_ROUTE`, allow skip/ready only when one of these is true:
  - terminal pathing fact for the expected accept-NPC route (`宝象国`);
  - fresh prepared `ROUTE_TRANSFER` / `宝象国`;
  - operation-bearing `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` with `ROUTE_TRANSFER` / `宝象国`.
- Do not let generic visible `OPTION/STORY`, operation-null attention, or `REQUESTED` alone skip
  park or release the duplicate-navigation gate.
- `PREPARING` should only be considered if it is tied to a fresh visible route dialog snapshot for
  the same target; otherwise treat it as “not ready yet”.
- Add rejected route-wake diagnostics that include event type, operation, target, pathing state,
  visible dialog type/source, status phase, and age.

Validation:

- No Java behavior changes were made in this heartbeat.

### 唐德 - 2026-06-18 Sprint CR18 operation-null WUBEI attention churn investigation

Status: DONE / investigation complete / waiting for approval before behavior code changes.

Context:

- Heartbeat `dhxy-sprint-board-task-check` found CR18 as Ready and Unclaimed.
- Claimed CR18 before work by setting Owner to 唐德 and Status to In Progress in
  `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Scope is investigation-first: inspect logs and call path for same-window churn where WUBEI visible
  STORY / `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` has `preparedOperation=null` while pathing remains `ACTIVE`.
- Do not change OCR/template/click/movement logic in this card without explicit approval.

Reviewed:

- `logs/dhxy-console.log`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/execution/WindowTaskRunner.java`
- `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`

Commands:

```powershell
rg -n "13:10:3[0-3].*(RESOLVE_AFTER_PATHING|skip park; runtime already has wake state|readyEventType=TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED|visibleDialogType=STORY|TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED|preparedOperation=null|pathingState=ACTIVE|consumePrepared|window.ready.await|tracker runner pathing still active|task attention)" logs\dhxy-console.log

rg -n "task attention published:.*visibleDialog=STORY.*preparedRoute=false|task attention prepared follow-up:.*visibleDialog=STORY.*preparedRoute=false|dialog-visible:STORY" logs\dhxy-console.log

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\analyze_wubei_latency.ps1 `
  -LogPath logs\dhxy-console.log `
  -StartTime "2026-06-18 13:09:07.000" `
  -EndTime "2026-06-18 13:17:00.000"
```

Evidence:

- Current log slice `2026-06-18 13:09:07.000` to `13:17:00.000` still shows heavy same-window churn:
  `task.turn.handoff.sameAsPrevious=769`, `wubei.wait.skipAlreadyReady=209`,
  `RESOLVE_AFTER_PATHING same=365 total=367`, `consumePrepared.absent=353`, and only
  `consumePrepared.consumed=4`.
- At `13:10:26.696`, `13:10:28.177`, and `13:10:32.739`, Runner publishes WUBEI
  `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` from `dialog-visible:STORY` with `operation=null`, `target=null`, and
  `preparedRoute=false`.
- The same window then repeatedly enters `wubei:RESOLVE_AFTER_PATHING`; `WubeiTask` logs
  `tracker runner pathing still active`, followed by `skip park; runtime already has wake state`.
  The captured state is the problematic combination:
  `pathingState=ACTIVE`, `preparedOperation=null`, `visibleDialogType=STORY`,
  `readyEventType=TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED`, `satisfied=true`.
- Code path:
  - `WindowTaskRunner.publishTaskAttentionIfDialogVisible(...)` detects any visible dialog, stores a
    `WindowDialogSnapshot`, then publishes a soft `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` before attempting prepared
    route/task-dialog follow-up. When follow-up fails, the published event remains
    `operation=null`.
  - `WubeiTask.isWaitAlreadySatisfied(...)` treats `DialogType.STORY` as actionable via
    `isActionableDialog(...)`.
  - For `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL`, this makes `isWaitAlreadySatisfied(...)` return true even when
    pathing is still `ACTIVE` and no prepared action exists.
  - `parkAfterYieldIfNeeded(...)` therefore skips the actual event wait and immediately lets the same
    transaction reacquire the turn.

Root cause:

- The ready-state semantics are too broad. A visible WUBEI `STORY` / operation-null
  `TASK_ATTENTION_REQUIRED` is useful as a diagnostic or one-shot nudge, but it is not strong enough
  to satisfy `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` repeatedly. It lacks both a terminal pathing state and a prepared
  operation-specific action, so the task has no next concrete action to consume.

Proposed change, pending approval:

- Keep Runner's visible-dialog publication as a soft wake, but narrow `WubeiTask`'s already-satisfied
  decision:
  - `WAIT_PATHING_TERMINAL` should be satisfied only by terminal pathing (`ARRIVED` /
    `STOPPED_AWAY`) or a fresh prepared action / operation-bearing ready event that matches the
    expected operation.
  - Operation-null visible `STORY` can cause one prompt recheck after an actual event wake, but must
    not repeatedly skip park while `pathingState=ACTIVE` and `preparedOperation=null`.
  - Add a rate-limited reject log for `skip park rejected`: wait reason, expected operation, visible
    dialog type/source, prepared operation/age, ready event type/operation, and pathing state.
- Do not change OCR/template thresholds, NPC click, minimap/world-map clicks, tracker green-click
  coordinates, or route option matching.

Validation:

- `scripts/analyze_wubei_latency.ps1` ran successfully on the current log slice and confirms the CR18
  churn counters above.
- No Java behavior changes were made in this heartbeat.

- 本轮先做日志/代码路径分析，不修改 Java、OCR/template、click/navigation 或业务顺序。

Planned inspection:

- `logs/dhxy-console.log` around fresh-run long-hold examples.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java` phase chain before `TRACKER_PATHING`.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/transaction/TaskTurnCoordinator.java` hold timing semantics.

Evidence:

- Fresh archived slice around `2026-06-18 12:03:25`:
  - `wubei:TRACKER_PATHING` transaction elapsed was about `1111ms`.
  - The same release logged `heldMs=17500`.
  - Therefore the slow hold was not the green tracker click itself; the task turn had already been
    held across earlier phase work before `TRACKER_PATHING`.
- Latest live slice around `2026-06-18 12:29:54` to `12:30:10` repeats the same shape:
  - `wubei:TRACKER_PATHING` started at `12:30:02.333`.
  - `wubei:TRACKER_PATHING` finished at `12:30:04.102`, `elapsedMs=1770`.
  - Release at `12:30:04.107` logged `heldMs=19543`.
  - The preceding same-window chain shows turn kept through `RETURN_HOME`, `WAIT_TEAM_RETURN`,
    `ACCEPT_TASK`, `READ_TRACKER`, `AFTER_ACCEPT_MAINTENANCE_CHECK`, and
    `BEFORE_TRACKER_PATHING_MAINTENANCE_CHECK`.
- Code confirms the timing semantics:
  - `TaskTurnCoordinator.enter(...)` sets `heldStartedAt` only when the thread first acquires the
    fair turn lock.
  - `TaskTurnCoordinator.leave(...)` keeps the turn for completed `READY_TO_CONTINUE` outcomes with
    `CONTINUE_CHAIN`.
  - `WubeiTask.runRoundPhases(...)` runs every phase through `TaskTransactionRunner.run(...)`, so a
    long chain of `READY_TO_CONTINUE` phases can be counted as one continuous task-turn hold.

Conclusion:

- CR13 is not primarily an input-click latency bug. It is a task-turn ownership boundary problem.
- `heldMs` reports the full continuous ownership window, while `task.transaction elapsedMs` reports
  only the current phase. In the bad examples, the current `TRACKER_PATHING` phase is around
  1.1-1.8s, but the turn has already been held for 17-19s.

Narrow patch plan pending approval:

1. Add a safe turn split at round boundary so `ROUND_DONE -> next round ACCEPT_TASK` cannot keep the
   same task turn through the next round.
2. Add a safe turn split after successful `ACCEPT_TASK` / tracker refresh handoff, before expensive
   `READ_TRACKER` + maintenance + tracker-click work continues.
3. Keep the business ordering unchanged: accept -> read tracker -> maintenance check -> tracker
   pathing. The patch should only change when the turn is released/reacquired between those steps.
4. Do not change OCR/template/click/movement logic in this CR13 fix.

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\analyze_wubei_latency.ps1 `
  -LogPath logs\dhxy-console.log `
  -StartTime "2026-06-18 12:29:54.000" `
  -EndTime "2026-06-18 12:30:10.000"
```

  -JsonOut $baseline
```

Compare a later run against baseline:

  -LogPath logs\dhxy-console.log `

```
